examples.cn: 平等[获取]优质教育是每个儿童的基本权利。

examples.en: Users can [access] their account information from any device with an internet connection.
examples.cn: 用户可以通过任何联网设备[访问]其账户信息。

examples.en: Journalists were denied [access] to the disaster zone for safety reasons.
examples.cn: 记者出于安全原因被拒绝[进入]灾区。

examples.en: The mountain village is only reachable via a narrow [access] road that closes in winter.
examples.cn: 这个山村只能通过一条冬季封路的狭窄[进山公路]到达。

examples.sense: adj. 可进入的；可到达的
examples.en: The new ramps and lifts make the museum fully [accessible] to wheelchair users.
examples.cn: 新建的坡道和电梯使博物馆对轮椅使用者完全[无障碍]。

examples.sense: adj. 易得到的；可获取的
examples.en: High-speed internet has made information [accessible] to people in remote areas.
examples.cn: 高速互联网使偏远地区的人们也能[获取]信息。

examples.sense: adj. 平易近人的；易接触的
examples.en: The professor was known for being [accessible] to students outside of class hours.
examples.cn: 这位教授以课外时间[平易近人]地接待学生而著称。

examples.en: The author wrote in an [accessible] style that appealed to both experts and general readers.
examples.cn: 作者以[浅显易懂]的风格写作，吸引了专家和普通读者。

examples.sense: adj. 负担得起的；价格合理的
examples.en: The charity aims to make healthy food more [accessible] to low-income communities.
examples.cn: 该慈善机构旨在让低收入社区更容易[获得]健康食品。

examples.en: The traffic [accident] caused severe disruption to the city's rush-hour commute.
examples.cn: 这起交通[事故]严重扰乱了城市高峰期的通勤。

examples.en: It was no [accident] that the two scientists independently reached the same conclusion.
examples.cn: 两位科学家独立得出相同结论，这绝非[偶然]。

examples.en: The industrial [accident] released toxic chemicals into the nearby river.
examples.cn: 这起工业[事故]将有毒化学物质释放到附近的河流中。

examples.en: By a fortunate [accident] of history, the manuscript survived for over five centuries.
examples.cn: 得益于历史的[偶然]，这份手稿保存了五百多年。

examples.en: Wearing a helmet significantly reduces the risk of serious injury in a cycling [accident].
examples.cn: 骑车[事故]中佩戴头盔可大幅降低严重受伤的风险。

examples.en: The university provides affordable [accommodation] for first-year students on campus.
examples.cn: 大学为大一学生提供校内经济实惠的[住处]。

examples.en: The school made special [accommodation] for students with learning disabilities.
examples.cn: 学校为有学习障碍的学生做出了特别[安排]。

examples.en: Reaching an [accommodation] between the two factions required months of negotiation.
examples.cn: 在两派之间达成[妥协]需要数月的谈判。

examples.en: The resort offers luxury [accommodation] including private villas and a spa.
examples.cn: 该度假村提供豪华[住宿]设施，包括私人别墅和水疗中心。

examples.en: The eye's [accommodation] reflex allows it to focus on objects at varying distances.
examples.cn: 眼睛的[调节]反射使其能够聚焦在不同距离的物体上。

examples.en: A translator [accompanied] the delegation throughout their visit to the foreign ministry.
examples.cn: 翻译[陪同]代表团全程参观了外交部。

examples.en: The pianist [accompanied] the soprano, providing a delicate musical backdrop.
examples.cn: 钢琴家为女高音[伴奏]，提供了细腻的音乐背景。

examples.en: The economic downturn was [accompanied] by a sharp rise in unemployment.
examples.cn: 经济衰退[伴随]着失业率的急剧上升。

examples.en: Each dish on the menu is [accompanied] by a suggested wine pairing.
examples.cn: 菜单上的每道菜都[附有]推荐的搭配葡萄酒。

examples.en: Parents were asked to [accompany] their children to the vaccination centre.
examples.cn: 家长被要求[陪同]子女前往接种中心。

examples.en: The team [accomplished] their mission despite facing numerous unexpected obstacles.
examples.cn: 尽管面临众多意外障碍，团队还是[完成]了任务。

examples.en: Regular practice is the most reliable way to [accomplish] mastery of any skill.
examples.cn: 定期练习是[实现]任何技能精通的最可靠方式。

examples.en: She [accomplished] more in her first year as principal than her predecessor did in five.
examples.cn: 她担任校长第一年所[取得的成就]超过了前任五年的工作量。

examples.en: With enough determination, anyone can [accomplish] goals that once seemed impossible.
examples.cn: 只要有足够的决心，任何人都能[实现]曾经看似不可能的目标。

examples.en: The surgeon [accomplished] the delicate operation without any complications.
examples.cn: 外科医生[圆满完成]了这台精细手术，没有任何并发症。

examples.en: She opened a savings [account] to manage her finances more effectively.
examples.cn: 她开设了一个储蓄[账户]，以便更有效地管理财务。

examples.en: The historian gave a detailed [account] of the events leading to the revolution.
examples.cn: 历史学家对导致革命的事件作了详细[叙述]。

examples.en: The report failed to [account] for the environmental impact of the new factory.
examples.cn: 该报告未能[说明]新工厂对环境的影响。

examples.sense: n. 原因；缘故（on account of）
examples.en: The match was postponed on [account] of the severe weather warning issued by authorities.
examples.cn: 比赛因当局发布的恶劣天气预警而[由于]延期。

examples.en: Renewable energy now [accounts] for nearly a third of the country's total power supply.
examples.cn: 可再生能源目前[占]该国总电力供应的近三分之一。

examples.en: The company hired a certified [accountant] to audit its financial records.
examples.cn: 公司聘请了一位注册[会计师]对其财务记录进行审计。

examples.en: As the firm's chief [accountant], he was responsible for all tax compliance matters.
examples.cn: 作为公司首席[会计]，他负责所有税务合规事项。

examples.en: The [accountant] discovered several discrepancies during the routine financial review.
examples.cn: [会计师]在例行财务审查中发现了几处差异。

examples.en: She worked as a junior [accountant] before earning her professional qualification.
examples.cn: 她在获得专业资格之前曾担任初级[会计员]。

examples.en: Many [accountants] must complete continuing education to maintain their licence.
examples.cn: 许多[会计师]必须接受继续教育才能保持执照有效。

examples.en: Over the years, she [accumulated] a vast collection of rare first-edition books.
examples.cn: 多年来，她[积累]了大量珍贵的初版书籍收藏。

examples.en: Dust [accumulated] on the shelves during the months the library was closed.
examples.cn: 图书馆关闭的数月间，灰尘在书架上[堆积]了起来。

examples.en: Evidence [accumulated] over decades before scientists reached a consensus on climate change.
examples.cn: 经过数十年的证据[积累]，科学家才就气候变化达成共识。

examples.en: The entrepreneur [accumulated] considerable wealth through disciplined investment strategies.
examples.cn: 这位企业家通过严格的投资策略[积累]了可观的财富。

examples.en: Delays in the project caused costs to [accumulate] far beyond the original budget.
examples.cn: 项目延误导致费用[不断增加]，远超原定预算。

examples.en: The [accuracy] of the weather forecast has improved dramatically with modern technology.
examples.cn: 借助现代技术，天气预报的[准确性]得到了显著提高。

examples.en: The archer's [accuracy] was remarkable — every arrow hit within centimetres of the target.
examples.cn: 射手的[精准度]令人印象深刻——每支箭都射中靶心附近数厘米处。

examples.en: Journalists have a professional obligation to verify the [accuracy] of their sources.
examples.cn: 记者有核实信息来源[准确性]的职业责任。

examples.en: The laboratory instrument measures temperature with an [accuracy] of 0.01 degrees Celsius.
examples.cn: 该实验室仪器的温度测量[精度]达到0.01摄氏度。

examples.en: Mathematical models can never achieve perfect [accuracy] when predicting complex systems.
examples.cn: 数学模型在预测复杂系统时永远无法达到完美的[精确性]。

examples.en: The opposition party [accused] the government of misusing public funds.
examples.cn: 反对党[指控]政府滥用公共资金。

examples.en: She [accused] her colleague of taking credit for her research without acknowledgement.
examples.cn: 她[谴责]同事在未经认可的情况下窃取了她的研究成果。

examples.en: He was formally [accused] of fraud and ordered to appear before the court.
examples.cn: 他被正式[指控]欺诈，并被命令出庭。

examples.sense: v. 怀疑；怀有指责之意
examples.en: The manager [accused] the supplier of deliberately delaying the shipment.
examples.cn: 经理[指责]供应商故意推迟发货。

examples.en: Critics [accused] the film of romanticising a morally complex historical figure.
examples.cn: 批评者[指责]该电影美化了一个道德复杂的历史人物。

examples.sense: adj. 习惯于……的（be accustomed to）
examples.en: After years abroad, she was no longer [accustomed] to the cold winters of her homeland.
examples.cn: 在海外多年后，她已不再[习惯]故乡寒冷的冬天。

examples.en: He took his [accustomed] seat at the head of the conference table.
examples.cn: 他坐在了会议桌首席的[惯常]位置。

examples.sense: adj. 适应了的；已习惯的
examples.en: New employees quickly become [accustomed] to the fast-paced culture of the company.
examples.cn: 新员工很快就[适应]了公司快节奏的文化。

examples.en: The professor delivered his lecture in his [accustomed] methodical style.
examples.cn: 教授以其[惯常]的系统性风格讲授课程。

examples.sense: adj. 熟悉的；习以为常的
examples.en: She was [accustomed] to working under pressure after years in the emergency department.
examples.cn: 在急诊科工作多年后，她已[习惯]了在压力下工作。

examples.en: A persistent [ache] in her lower back prompted her to see a specialist.
examples.cn: 下背部持续的[疼痛]促使她去看了专科医生。

examples.en: His muscles [ached] after the intensive training session at the gym.
examples.cn: 经过健身房的高强度训练后，他的肌肉[酸痛]不已。

examples.en: She [ached] to return to her hometown after years of living far away.
examples.cn: 在外生活多年后，她[渴望]回到故乡。

examples.en: The [ache] of losing a close friend never fully disappears with the passage of time.
examples.cn: 失去挚友的[心痛]随着时间的流逝从未完全消散。

examples.sense: v. 令人心疼；令人难受
examples.en: It [ached] him to see his students struggle without adequate resources.
examples.cn: 看到学生们在资源匮乏中挣扎，令他[心痛]。

examples.en: With dedication and hard work, students can [achieve] their academic goals.
examples.cn: 凭借专注和努力，学生们可以[实现]自己的学业目标。

examples.en: The scientist [achieved] international recognition for her pioneering research on gene therapy.
examples.cn: 这位科学家因其在基因治疗方面的开创性研究而[获得]国际认可。

examples.en: The peace negotiators [achieved] what many thought was impossible — a lasting ceasefire.
examples.cn: 和平谈判者[做到]了许多人认为不可能的事——达成持久停火。

examples.en: The project team [achieved] all its milestones ahead of the scheduled deadline.
examples.cn: 项目团队提前[完成]了所有里程碑节点。

examples.en: The new policy [achieved] its intended effect of reducing carbon emissions by fifteen percent.
examples.cn: 新政策[达到]了预期效果，将碳排放量减少了15%。

examples.en: Winning the national essay competition was her greatest academic [achievement].
examples.cn: 赢得全国作文比赛是她最重要的学术[成就]。

examples.en: The [achievement] of sustainable development requires collective international effort.
examples.cn: 可持续发展目标的[实现]需要国际社会的共同努力。

examples.en: The bridge stands as a remarkable engineering [achievement] of the twentieth century.
examples.cn: 这座桥梁是二十世纪一项卓越的工程[成就]。

examples.en: The team celebrated their [achievement] with a small but heartfelt gathering.
examples.cn: 团队用一次小而真诚的聚会庆祝他们的[成功]。

examples.en: Academic [achievement] is not solely measured by examination scores.
examples.cn: 学业[成就]不能仅凭考试分数来衡量。

examples.en: Vinegar contains [acid] that can damage tooth enamel if consumed excessively.
examples.cn: 醋含有[酸]，若过量摄入会损伤牙釉质。

examples.en: The [acid] taste of the unripe mango made her eyes water.
examples.cn: 未成熟芒果的[酸]味让她泪眼蒙眬。

examples.en: His [acid] wit often amused colleagues but occasionally caused offence.
examples.cn: 他[尖刻]的机智常常让同事们发笑，但有时也会令人不快。

examples.en: In the laboratory, students learned how to handle [acids] and bases safely.
examples.cn: 在实验室，学生们学习了如何安全处理[酸]和碱。

examples.en: Certain crops thrive in [acid] soil conditions that other plants find inhospitable.
examples.cn: 某些作物在其他植物难以适应的[酸性]土壤条件下茁壮生长。

examples.en: The politician finally [acknowledged] that mistakes had been made in handling the crisis.
examples.cn: 这位政治家终于[承认]在处理危机过程中存在失误。

examples.en: Please [acknowledge] receipt of this email at your earliest convenience.
examples.cn: 请尽早[确认]收到本邮件。

examples.en: The author [acknowledged] the support of her research team in the book's preface.
examples.cn: 作者在书的前言中[致谢]了研究团队的支持。

examples.en: He [acknowledged] her presence with a brief nod as he passed her in the corridor.
examples.cn: 他在走廊经过她时，用一个简短的点头[示意]认出了她。

examples.en: She is widely [acknowledged] as one of the leading experts in renewable energy.
examples.cn: 她被广泛[认定]为可再生能源领域的顶尖专家之一。

examples.en: He was not a close friend but rather a professional [acquaintance] from the conference.
examples.cn: 他不是亲密的朋友，而是会议上的一位工作[相识]。

examples.en: Their [acquaintance] began with a chance encounter at a bookshop ten years ago.
examples.cn: 他们的[相识]始于十年前在书店的一次偶然邂逅。

examples.en: A basic [acquaintance] with statistics is essential for interpreting research data.
examples.cn: 对统计学的基本[了解]是解读研究数据的必要条件。

examples.en: Through his wide [acquaintance], he was able to secure introductions to key investors.
examples.cn: 通过广泛的[人脉]，他得以获得引荐，接触到关键投资者。

examples.sense: n. 初步认识；浅层了解
examples.en: One's [acquaintance] with a subject deepens over time through sustained study.
examples.cn: 对一个学科的[了解]会随着持续学习而不断深化。

examples.en: She [acquired] fluency in Mandarin after living in Beijing for three years.
examples.cn: 在北京生活三年后，她[获得]了流利的普通话能力。

examples.en: The corporation [acquired] its main competitor for a sum of two billion dollars.
examples.cn: 该公司以20亿美元[收购]了其主要竞争对手。

examples.en: Reading widely helps students [acquire] a broader vocabulary over time.
examples.cn: 广泛阅读帮助学生随着时间推移[积累]更丰富的词汇量。

examples.en: He [acquired] a rare tropical illness during his fieldwork in the rainforest.
examples.cn: 他在雨林实地考察期间[感染]了一种罕见的热带疾病。

examples.en: The internship allowed her to [acquire] practical skills not taught in the classroom.
examples.cn: 实习让她[获得]了课堂上无法学到的实践技能。

examples.en: The [acquisition] of critical thinking skills is a central goal of modern education.
examples.cn: 批判性思维能力的[获取]是现代教育的核心目标。

examples.en: The [acquisition] of the smaller firm strengthened the company's position in the market.
examples.cn: 对这家较小公司的[收购]巩固了该公司在市场中的地位。

examples.sense: n. 购置物；新添的财产
examples.en: The museum's latest [acquisition] is a priceless medieval manuscript donated by a private collector.
examples.cn: 博物馆最新[购置]的藏品是一位私人收藏家捐赠的珍贵中世纪手稿。

examples.en: Researchers study how children's first language [acquisition] differs from learning a second language.
examples.cn: 研究人员研究儿童第一语言[习得]与学习第二语言的差异。

examples.en: The [acquisition] of specialist knowledge requires years of focused study and practice.
examples.cn: 专业知识的[积累]需要多年有针对性的学习和实践。

examples.sense: n. 英亩（土地面积单位）
examples.en: The estate covers over five hundred [acres] of farmland in the countryside.
examples.cn: 该庄园在乡村占地超过五百[英亩]农田。

examples.sense: n. 大片土地（复数，泛指）
examples.en: [Acres] of tropical rainforest are destroyed every year due to illegal logging.
examples.cn: 每年有大片的热带雨林因非法采伐而被摧毁。

examples.en: The farm produces roughly three tonnes of wheat per [acre] during a good harvest.
examples.cn: 在丰收年景，该农场每[英亩]可生产约三吨小麦。

examples.en: The school's sports facilities occupy nearly four [acres] of the campus.
examples.cn: 学校的体育设施占据了校园近四[英亩]的面积。

examples.en: God's Little [Acre] is a classic American novel dealing with land ownership and rural poverty.
examples.cn: 《上帝的小[英亩]》是一部讲述土地所有权与农村贫困的美国经典小说。

examples.en: The children ran [across] the field to reach the ice-cream van on the other side.
examples.cn: 孩子们[穿越]田野，跑向对面的冰淇淋车。

examples.en: The charity operates [across] more than fifty countries worldwide.
examples.cn: 该慈善机构在全球五十多个国家[各处]开展工作。

examples.en: She waved to her neighbour [across] the street before entering the house.
examples.cn: 她进屋前向[对街]的邻居挥了挥手。

examples.en: The ancient ruins are located [across] the river, accessible only by boat.
examples.cn: 古遗址位于[河的对岸]，只能乘船到达。

examples.en: The reforms were welcomed [across] all sectors of the business community.
examples.cn: 改革受到商界[各个]部门的欢迎。

examples.en: Governments must [act] decisively to address the growing threat of climate change.
examples.cn: 各国政府必须果断[采取行动]，应对日益严峻的气候变化威胁。

examples.en: Donating to charity is an [act] of generosity that benefits the entire community.
examples.cn: 向慈善机构捐款是一种惠及整个社区的[慷慨举动]。

examples.en: The parliament passed an [act] to strengthen environmental protection standards.
examples.cn: 议会通过了一项加强环保标准的[法案]。

examples.en: She has [acted] in several internationally acclaimed films and television series.
examples.cn: 她曾在多部国际知名电影和电视剧中[出演]。

examples.en: The most dramatic scene occurs in the third [act], when the truth is finally revealed.
examples.cn: 最戏剧性的场景发生在第三[幕]，真相终于大白于天下。

examples.en: Prompt [action] was taken to contain the outbreak before it spread further.
examples.cn: 迅速[采取行动]遏制了疫情的进一步扩散。

examples.en: The company faced legal [action] after failing to compensate the injured workers.
examples.cn: 该公司因未能赔偿受伤工人而面临法律[诉讼]。

examples.en: The soldiers showed great courage during the [action] in the mountain passes.
examples.cn: 士兵们在山口[战斗]中表现出了极大的勇气。

examples.sense: n. 效果；作用（化学、物理）
examples.en: The [action] of the enzyme accelerates the breakdown of complex proteins.
examples.cn: 该酶的[作用]加速了复杂蛋白质的分解。

examples.en: The play is full of [action], keeping the audience engaged from start to finish.
examples.cn: 该剧[情节]紧凑，使观众从头到尾全神贯注。

examples.en: She has been an [active] participant in the school's environmental campaign for three years.
examples.cn: 她三年来一直是学校环保运动的[积极]参与者。

examples.sense: adj. 活动中的；运转中的
examples.en: The volcano remains [active] and is monitored continuously by geologists.
examples.cn: 这座火山仍处于[活跃]状态，地质学家对其进行持续监测。

examples.en: Doctors recommend that children remain physically [active] for at least one hour a day.
examples.cn: 医生建议儿童每天至少保持一小时的身体[活动]。

examples.en: Several [active] members of the organisation volunteered to lead the community project.
examples.cn: 该组织的几名[积极]成员自愿领导社区项目。

examples.en: In the [active] voice, the subject performs the action described by the verb.
examples.cn: 在[主动]语态中，主语执行动词所描述的动作。

examples.en: Extracurricular [activities] help students develop skills beyond the academic curriculum.
examples.cn: 课外[活动]帮助学生培养学术课程以外的技能。

examples.en: Volcanic [activity] in the region has increased significantly over the past decade.
examples.cn: 该地区的火山[活动]在过去十年中显著增加。

examples.en: The charity's core [activity] is providing education to underprivileged children.
examples.cn: 该慈善机构的核心[工作]是为贫困儿童提供教育。

examples.en: Police monitored suspicious [activity] near the warehouse for several weeks.
examples.cn: 警察对仓库附近的可疑[活动]进行了数周监视。

examples.en: The [activity] in the stock market reflected growing investor confidence in the economy.
examples.cn: 股市的[活跃]反映出投资者对经济的信心不断增强。

examples.en: The [actor] delivered a powerful performance that earned him a standing ovation.
examples.cn: 这位[演员]奉献了精彩的表演，赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

examples.en: Non-governmental organisations are important [actors] in international development work.
examples.cn: 非政府组织是国际发展工作中的重要[参与者]。

examples.en: The key [actors] in the trade negotiations included representatives from six countries.
examples.cn: 贸易谈判的主要[参与方]包括来自六个国家的代表。

examples.en: She trained as a stage [actor] before transitioning to film and television.
examples.cn: 她曾受训成为舞台[演员]，后来转向电影和电视行业。

examples.sense: n. 假扮者；装腔作势者（比喻）
examples.en: A skilled politician is sometimes compared to an [actor] playing a role before an audience.
examples.cn: 技艺娴熟的政治家有时被比作在观众面前扮演角色的[演员]。

examples.en: The [actress] won the award for her emotionally complex portrayal of a war refugee.
examples.cn: 这位[女演员]凭借对战争难民的情感复杂刻画获得了该奖项。

examples.en: She began her career as a theatre [actress] before gaining international fame in cinema.
examples.cn: 她职业生涯始于剧院[女演员]，后来在影坛名扬国际。

examples.en: The veteran [actress] has appeared in over sixty films spanning four decades.
examples.cn: 这位资深[女演员]在四十年间参演了六十多部影片。

examples.en: The young [actress] showed extraordinary talent in the lead role of the school play.
examples.cn: 年轻[女演员]在学校话剧中担任主角，展现了非凡的才华。

examples.sense: n. 女性角色扮演者（比喻）
examples.en: In the political arena, she proved herself not merely an [actress] but a genuine leader.
examples.cn: 在政治舞台上，她证明自己不仅仅是一名[表演者]，更是真正的领导者。

examples.en: The [actual] cost of the project exceeded the estimated budget by thirty percent.
examples.cn: 该项目的[实际]成本超出预算30%。

examples.en: Many people confuse the myth with the [actual] historical events it is based on.
examples.cn: 许多人将神话与其所依据的[真实]历史事件混淆。

examples.sense: adj. 当前的；现今的（强调）
examples.en: The theory sounds compelling, but [actual] evidence to support it remains scarce.
examples.cn: 这个理论听起来很有说服力，但支持它的[实际]证据仍然匮乏。

examples.en: The [actual] situation on the ground was far more complex than the reports suggested.
examples.cn: 实地的[实际]情况远比报道所描述的复杂。

examples.en: We must assess the [actual] needs of the community before designing the programme.
examples.cn: 我们必须在设计方案之前评估社区的[实际]需求。

examples.sense: adj. 剧烈的；急性的（疾病）
examples.en: He was admitted to hospital with [acute] appendicitis and required emergency surgery.
examples.cn: 他因[急性]阑尾炎入院，需要接受紧急手术。

examples.en: Her [acute] observation skills made her exceptionally effective as an investigator.
examples.cn: 她[敏锐]的观察能力使她作为调查人员格外出色。

examples.en: There is an [acute] shortage of qualified teachers in many rural schools.
examples.cn: 许多农村学校面临合格教师[严重]短缺的问题。

examples.en: An [acute] angle measures less than ninety degrees, unlike an obtuse angle.
examples.cn: [锐]角小于九十度，不同于钝角。

examples.en: Her [acute] business sense allowed her to identify profitable opportunities others had missed.
examples.cn: 她[敏锐]的商业头脑让她发现了他人忽视的盈利机会。

examples.sense: v. 适应；调整（以适应新环境）
examples.en: Species that cannot [adapt] to changing environments face the risk of extinction.
examples.cn: 无法[适应]环境变化的物种面临灭绝风险。

examples.en: The novel was [adapted] into a critically acclaimed film by an award-winning director.
examples.cn: 这部小说被[改编]成一部广受好评的电影，由获奖导演执导。

examples.en: The curriculum was [adapted] to meet the diverse learning needs of all students.
examples.cn: 课程被[调整]以满足所有学生多样化的学习需求。

examples.en: Expatriates often need time to [adapt] to different cultural norms and social expectations.
examples.cn: 海外侨民通常需要时间来[适应]不同的文化规范和社会期望。

examples.sense: v. 利用改造（机器、设备）
examples.en: Engineers [adapted] the existing design to function in extreme Arctic conditions.
examples.cn: 工程师将现有设计[改造]以适应极端北极条件。

examples.en: The camel's ability to store water is a classic example of evolutionary [adaptation].
examples.cn: 骆驼储存水的能力是进化[适应]的经典例子。

examples.en: The stage [adaptation] of the novel attracted large audiences for its innovative interpretation.
examples.cn: 该小说的舞台[改编版]以其创新诠释吸引了大批观众。

examples.en: Successful [adaptation] to a new culture requires both patience and open-mindedness.
examples.cn: 成功[适应]新文化需要耐心和开放的心态。

examples.en: The thick fur of arctic foxes is an [adaptation] to their freezing habitat.
examples.cn: 北极狐的浓密皮毛是对其冰冻栖息地的[适应]。

examples.en: The building required significant [adaptation] to become accessible for disabled visitors.
examples.cn: 该建筑需要进行大规模[改造]，以便残疾访客无障碍进入。

examples.en: The chef suggested [adding] a pinch of salt to enhance the flavour of the dish.
examples.cn: 厨师建议[加入]少许盐以增强菜肴的风味。

examples.en: The spokesperson [added] that further details would be released at the press conference.
examples.cn: 发言人[补充说]，更多细节将在新闻发布会上公布。

examples.en: If you [add] fifteen and twenty-seven, the sum is forty-two.
examples.cn: 如果你将十五与二十七[相加]，总和为四十二。

examples.en: The renovation [added] considerable value to the property in the competitive market.
examples.cn: 翻新在竞争激烈的市场中为该房产[增添]了相当大的价值。

examples.en: Please [add] your contact details at the bottom of the application form.
examples.cn: 请在申请表底部[填上]您的联系方式。

examples.sense: adj. 上瘾的；沉迷的（be addicted to）
examples.en: He became [addicted] to online gaming, neglecting his studies and social life.
examples.cn: 他沉迷于网络游戏，荒废了学业和社交生活。

examples.en: The rehabilitation centre helps people who are [addicted] to alcohol or drugs to recover.
examples.cn: 康复中心帮助[沉迷]于酒精或毒品的人们康复。

examples.en: She admits to being completely [addicted] to detective novels and reads one every week.
examples.cn: 她承认自己完全[迷上]了侦探小说，每周阅读一本。

examples.en: Once [addicted] to social media, many teenagers find it difficult to disconnect.
examples.cn: 一旦[沉迷]于社交媒体，许多青少年就发现很难断开。

examples.sense: adj. 成瘾性的（使人上瘾）
examples.en: The psychologist warned that certain smartphone behaviours can become [addicted] patterns.
examples.cn: 心理学家警告，某些智能手机行为可能演变为[成瘾]模式。

examples.en: The [addition] of solar panels to the roof reduced the building's energy costs significantly.
examples.cn: 在屋顶[增设]太阳能电池板大幅降低了建筑的能源费用。

examples.en: Basic [addition] and subtraction are the foundation of all mathematical reasoning.
examples.cn: 基本[加减法]是所有数学推理的基础。

examples.en: The new wing is a welcome [addition] to the museum's already impressive collection.
examples.cn: 新翼楼是博物馆已令人叹为观止的收藏品的一次令人欣喜的[新增]。

examples.en: In [addition] to her academic qualifications, she has five years of professional experience.
examples.cn: 除学术资质外，她还有五年的从业经验。

examples.en: The latest [addition] to the research team brings expertise in artificial intelligence.
examples.cn: 研究团队的最新[成员]带来了人工智能方面的专业知识。

examples.en: Please ensure your postal [address] is clearly written on the application form.
examples.cn: 请确保在申请表上清楚填写您的邮寄[地址]。

examples.en: The president [addressed] the nation in a live broadcast regarding the economic crisis.
examples.cn: 总统就经济危机向全国进行了现场直播[演讲]。

examples.en: The new policy aims to [address] the growing inequality between urban and rural areas.
examples.cn: 新政策旨在[解决]城乡之间日益扩大的不平等问题。

examples.en: His inaugural [address] outlined an ambitious plan for educational reform.
examples.cn: 他的就职[演说]概述了一项雄心勃勃的教育改革计划。

examples.en: Students are expected to [address] their teachers formally in the classroom.
examples.cn: 学生在课堂上应正式[称呼]老师。

examples.en: The relief organisation ensured that [adequate] food supplies reached all affected areas.
examples.cn: 救援组织确保所有受灾地区都获得了[充足]的食物供应。

examples.en: The performance was [adequate] but lacked the brilliance expected of a professional ensemble.
examples.cn: 此次演出[差强人意]，但缺乏专业乐团应有的光彩。

examples.sense: adj. 胜任的；能满足要求的
examples.en: His language skills proved [adequate] for the basic tasks required of the position.
examples.cn: 他的语言能力证明[足以]胜任该职位所需的基本任务。

examples.en: Authorities must provide [adequate] legal representation for all defendants regardless of income.
examples.cn: 当局必须为所有被告提供[充分]的法律代理，不论其收入如何。

examples.sense: adj. 恰到好处的（勉强满足）
examples.en: The shelter provided only [adequate] protection from the rain but little warmth.
examples.cn: 避难所仅提供了[勉强足够]的遮雨保护，但几乎没有温暖。

examples.en: Please [adjust] the thermostat if you find the room temperature uncomfortable.
examples.cn: 如果您觉得室温不舒适，请[调节]恒温器。

examples.en: It took her several months to fully [adjust] to life in a new country.
examples.cn: 她花了几个月时间才完全[适应]新国家的生活。

examples.en: The editor [adjusted] several passages of the manuscript to improve clarity.
examples.cn: 编辑[修改]了手稿的几个段落以提高表达清晰度。

examples.en: The technician [adjusted] the microscope to achieve a sharper focus.
examples.cn: 技术员[校准]了显微镜以获得更清晰的焦距。

examples.en: She [adjusted] her tie and took a deep breath before entering the interview room.
examples.cn: 她进入面试室前[整了整]领带，深吸了一口气。

examples.en: Minor [adjustments] to the production process led to a twenty percent increase in efficiency.
examples.cn: 对生产流程的细微[调整]使效率提高了20%。

examples.en: The [adjustment] to university life can be challenging for students from rural backgrounds.
examples.cn: 对于来自农村背景的学生来说，[适应]大学生活可能颇具挑战。

examples.en: The [adjustment] of the satellite's orbit requires precise calculations and timing.
examples.cn: 卫星轨道的[校正]需要精确的计算和时机把握。

examples.en: Reaching an [adjustment] in the contract dispute required both parties to make concessions.
examples.cn: 解决合同纠纷需要双方[妥协]，各作让步。

examples.en: The budget required significant [adjustments] after the unexpected economic downturn.
examples.cn: 意外的经济下滑后，预算需要进行重大[调整]。

examples.en: Effective hospital [administration] is essential for delivering high-quality patient care.
examples.cn: 有效的医院[管理]对于提供高质量的患者护理至关重要。

examples.en: The new [administration] pledged to prioritise job creation and economic recovery.
examples.cn: 新[政府]承诺将把创造就业和经济复苏放在首位。

examples.en: The [administration] of the vaccine programme required careful coordination nationwide.
examples.cn: 疫苗接种项目的[实施]需要全国范围内的精心协调。

examples.en: Students with complaints should first contact the university's [administration] office.
examples.cn: 有投诉的学生应首先联系大学的[行政]办公室。

examples.en: The [administration] of the correct dosage is critical in treating the condition safely.
examples.cn: 正确剂量的[给药]对于安全治疗该病症至关重要。

examples.sense: adj. 值得称赞的；令人钦佩的
examples.en: Her [admirable] dedication to public service inspired many young people to volunteer.
examples.cn: 她[令人钦佩]的公共服务奉献精神激励了许多年轻人参与志愿工作。

examples.en: The rescue team displayed [admirable] courage in the face of overwhelming danger.
examples.cn: 救援队在极大危险面前表现出了[出色]的勇气。

examples.sense: adj. 高尚的；值得效仿的
examples.en: Honesty, even when inconvenient, is an [admirable] quality in any professional.
examples.cn: 诚实，即使不合时宜，也是任何专业人士[值得称道]的品质。

examples.en: The architect's [admirable] use of natural light transformed the interior space beautifully.
examples.cn: 建筑师对自然采光的[精湛]运用使室内空间焕然一新。

examples.sense: adj. 受人赞美的；出类拔萃的
examples.en: His [admirable] academic record earned him a place at one of the world's top universities.
examples.cn: 他[出色]的学业记录为他赢得了世界顶级大学的入学资格。

examples.en: Many young scientists [admire] Marie Curie for her pioneering achievements in physics.
examples.cn: 许多年轻科学家[钦佩]玛丽·居里在物理学领域的开创性成就。

examples.sense: v. 欣赏；赞美（景色、作品）
examples.en: Tourists paused to [admire] the breathtaking panorama from the mountain summit.
examples.cn: 游客们停下脚步[欣赏]山顶壮观的全景。

examples.en: He [admired] her ability to remain calm under extreme pressure during the crisis.
examples.cn: 他[赞赏]她在危机中极度压力下保持冷静的能力。

examples.en: She had long [admired] his integrity and fairness as a community leader.
examples.cn: 作为社区领导者，她长期以来[仰慕]他的诚信和公正。

examples.en: They spent the evening [admiring] the intricate architecture of the ancient cathedral.
examples.cn: 他们花了整个傍晚[观赏]这座古老大教堂错综复杂的建筑。

examples.en: [Admission] to the national park is free for children under twelve years of age.
examples.cn: 十二岁以下的儿童[进入]国家公园免费。

examples.en: She received [admission] to her first-choice medical school after years of preparation.
examples.cn: 经过多年的准备，她收到了第一志愿医学院的[录取]通知。

examples.en: His [admission] of guilt in court brought the lengthy trial to an end.
examples.cn: 他在法庭上[供认]有罪，使漫长的审判画上了句号。

examples.en: The number of hospital [admissions] for respiratory illness rose sharply in winter.
examples.cn: 冬季呼吸道疾病的医院[入院]人数急剧上升。

examples.en: [Admission] to the professional association requires passing a rigorous competency examination.
examples.cn: [加入]该专业协会需要通过严格的能力考试。

examples.en: The contractor finally [admitted] that the building had not been inspected properly.
examples.cn: 承包商终于[承认]该建筑没有经过适当检查。

examples.en: Only ticket holders will be [admitted] to the venue on the evening of the performance.
examples.cn: 演出当晚只有持票者才被[允许进入]场地。

examples.en: The patient was [admitted] to the intensive care unit following the emergency operation.
examples.cn: 患者紧急手术后被[收入]重症监护病房。

examples.en: She [admitted] to feeling overwhelmed by the demands of her new role.
examples.cn: 她[坦承]被新职位的要求压得喘不过气来。

examples.en: The report [admits] the possibility that human error contributed to the accident.
examples.cn: 报告[承认]人为失误可能是事故的原因之一。

examples.sense: n. 青春期；青少年时期
examples.en: [Adolescence] is a period of significant physical, emotional, and social development.
examples.cn: [青春期]是身体、情感和社会发展的重要阶段。

examples.en: Psychologists study how experiences during [adolescence] shape adult personality and behaviour.
examples.cn: 心理学家研究[青春期]的经历如何塑造成年人的个性和行为。

examples.en: The novel beautifully captures the confusion and self-discovery of [adolescence].
examples.cn: 这部小说精美地描绘了[青春期]的困惑与自我发现。

examples.en: During [adolescence], peer relationships become increasingly important to young people.
examples.cn: 在[青春期]，同伴关系对年轻人变得越来越重要。

examples.en: The technology is still in its [adolescence] and will mature over the next decade.
examples.cn: 这项技术仍处于[初期]阶段，将在未来十年内趋于成熟。

examples.en: Mental health services for [adolescents] are critically underfunded in many regions.
examples.cn: 许多地区针对[青少年]的心理健康服务严重资金不足。

examples.sense: adj. 青春期的；未成熟的
examples.en: His [adolescent] behaviour during the meeting embarrassed the entire delegation.
examples.cn: 他在会议上的[幼稚]行为令整个代表团感到尴尬。

examples.en: The programme encourages [adolescents] to develop leadership and communication skills.
examples.cn: 该项目鼓励[青少年]培养领导力和沟通能力。

examples.en: The study examined how social media affects [adolescent] self-esteem and body image.
examples.cn: 该研究探讨了社交媒体如何影响[青少年]的自尊和身体形象。

examples.sense: adj. 幼稚的；不成熟的（贬义）
examples.en: Her colleagues grew frustrated with his [adolescent] refusal to take responsibility.
examples.cn: 他[幼稚]地拒绝承担责任，让同事们感到沮丧。

examples.en: The couple decided to [adopt] a child after being unable to have children of their own.
examples.cn: 这对夫妇在无法生育后决定[收养]一个孩子。

examples.en: The school board voted to [adopt] a new curriculum focusing on digital literacy.
examples.cn: 学校董事会投票[采纳]了一项以数字素养为核心的新课程。

examples.en: The committee [adopted] a cautious approach in response to the unexpected crisis.
examples.cn: 委员会[采取]了谨慎态度来应对突如其来的危机。

examples.sense: v. 习得；接受（习惯、风格）
examples.en: She [adopted] a more diplomatic tone after receiving feedback from her mentor.
examples.cn: 在收到导师的反馈后，她[改用]了更有外交风范的语气。

examples.en: The United Nations [adopted] a resolution calling for immediate humanitarian aid.
examples.cn: 联合国[通过]了一项呼吁立即提供人道主义援助的决议。

examples.en: Fans across the world [adore] the singer for her powerful voice and authentic persona.
examples.cn: 世界各地的粉丝[崇拜]这位歌手，因为她拥有强大的嗓音和真实的个性。

examples.en: She absolutely [adores] classical music and attends concerts whenever possible.
examples.cn: 她[极为喜爱]古典音乐，只要有机会就会去听音乐会。

examples.en: He [adored] his grandmother and treasured every moment spent with her in her final years.
examples.cn: 他深深[爱慕]祖母，珍视在她晚年与她相处的每一刻。

examples.sense: v. 敬拜；顶礼膜拜（宗教）
examples.en: Pilgrims travelled great distances to [adore] the sacred relics housed in the cathedral.
examples.cn: 朝圣者不远万里前来[朝拜]存放在大教堂中的圣物。

examples.en: She [adored] the intricate detail in the artist's latest series of paintings.
examples.cn: 她[十分欣赏]艺术家最新系列绘画中的精细细节。

examples.en: The film is rated for [adults] only due to its mature themes and graphic content.
examples.cn: 该电影因其成熟主题和露骨内容而被评为仅限[成年人]观看。

examples.en: [Adult] education programmes give people a second chance to gain qualifications.
examples.cn: [成人]教育项目给人们提供了再次获得资格证书的机会。

examples.sense: n. 有完全行为能力的人
examples.en: As an [adult], she was legally responsible for her own financial decisions.
examples.cn: 作为[成年人]，她对自己的财务决定负有法律责任。

examples.sense: adj. 面向成人的；专为成人设计的
examples.en: The library hosts [adult] reading groups that meet on the first Tuesday of each month.
examples.cn: 图书馆举办[成人]读书小组，每月第一个星期二举行。

examples.en: The [adult] monarch butterfly migrates thousands of kilometres to warmer climates.
examples.cn: 帝王蝶[成虫]迁徙数千公里前往更温暖的气候地带。

examples.en: The troops [advanced] steadily through the difficult terrain under enemy fire.
examples.cn: 部队在敌方炮火下稳步[推进]穿越复杂地形。

examples.en: The [advance] of medical technology has transformed the treatment of previously fatal diseases.
examples.cn: 医疗技术的[进步]改变了对以前致命疾病的治疗方式。

examples.en: The new partnership will [advance] research into sustainable energy solutions.
examples.cn: 新伙伴关系将[推进]可持续能源解决方案的研究。

examples.en: Tickets must be purchased in [advance] as the event is expected to sell out quickly.
examples.cn: 门票必须[提前]购买，因为活动预计很快售罄。

examples.en: The publisher offered the author a substantial [advance] against future royalties.
examples.cn: 出版商向作者预付了一笔可观的[预付款]，以抵扣未来版税。

examples.en: Bilingual students have a significant [advantage] when applying for international positions.
examples.cn: 双语学生在申请国际职位时具有显著[优势]。

examples.en: One [advantage] of living in a city is the convenient access to public transportation.
examples.cn: 城市生活的一个[好处]是公共交通便利。

examples.sense: v. 有利于；使获益（take advantage of）
examples.en: She [took advantage of] the scholarship opportunity to study at a leading university abroad.
examples.cn: 她[利用]奖学金机会在国外顶尖大学求学。

examples.en: After a long deuce, the server finally gained the [advantage] to win the set.
examples.cn: 经过漫长的平局后，发球方终于获得[占先]赢得了这一局。

examples.en: Local knowledge gave the home team a decided [advantage] over their visitors.
examples.cn: 对主场的熟悉给主队带来了相对客队的明显[优势]。

examples.en: Travelling through remote mountain regions was the greatest [adventure] of her life.
examples.cn: 穿越偏远山区是她一生中最大的[冒险]。

examples.en: A spirit of [adventure] drove him to explore territories that no researcher had visited before.
examples.cn: [冒险]精神驱使他探索了此前没有研究人员到访的领域。

examples.sense: n. 刺激经历；新鲜体验
examples.en: Starting a new business is always an [adventure] filled with uncertainty and excitement.
examples.cn: 创业始终是一场充满不确定性和兴奋的[冒险]。

examples.en: The young journalist [adventured] into the war zone to report on the humanitarian crisis.
examples.cn: 年轻记者[冒险]进入战区，报道人道主义危机。

examples.en: The school's outdoor [adventure] programme builds resilience and teamwork among students.
examples.cn: 学校的户外[探险]项目培养了学生的韧性和团队合作精神。

examples.en: The company [advertised] its new product range through social media campaigns.
examples.cn: 该公司通过社交媒体活动[宣传]了其新产品系列。

examples.en: The hospital [advertised] several vacancies for experienced nursing staff last month.
examples.cn: 医院上个月[刊登广告]招聘数名有经验的护理人员。

examples.en: He preferred not to [advertise] his charitable donations, choosing to give anonymously.
examples.cn: 他不喜欢[张扬]自己的慈善捐款，选择匿名捐赠。

examples.en: The tourism board invested heavily to [advertise] the region's natural attractions worldwide.
examples.cn: 旅游局大量投资在全球[推广]该地区的自然景观。

examples.en: The university [advertised] the change in exam dates on its official website.
examples.cn: 大学在其官方网站上[公告]了考试日期的变更。

examples.en: The television [advertisement] for the new car featured stunning mountain landscapes.
examples.cn: 这款新车的电视[广告]以壮观的山地景观为背景。

examples.en: She responded to an [advertisement] in the newspaper for a position in marketing.
examples.cn: 她回应了报纸上的一则市场营销职位[招聘启事]。

examples.en: The [advertisement] campaign significantly boosted the charity's donation figures.
examples.cn: [广告]宣传活动大幅提升了该慈善机构的捐款数额。

examples.en: His brilliant performance was the best possible [advertisement] for the academy's training methods.
examples.cn: 他精彩的表现是对学院培训方法的最佳[宣传]。

examples.en: A prominent [advertisement] at the entrance informed visitors of the new opening hours.
examples.cn: 入口处的一则显眼[公告]告知访客新的开放时间。

examples.en: Her mentor gave her invaluable [advice] on how to navigate the competitive job market.
examples.cn: 她的导师就如何应对竞争激烈的就业市场给了她宝贵的[建议]。

examples.en: Before making any major investment, it is wise to seek professional financial [advice].
examples.cn: 在进行任何重大投资之前，寻求专业的财务[建议]是明智的。

examples.en: Despite repeated [advice] from doctors, he continued to smoke two packets a day.
examples.cn: 尽管医生多次[劝告]，他仍继续每天抽两包烟。

examples.en: The bank sent [advice] confirming the successful transfer of funds to the account.
examples.cn: 银行发送了[通知]，确认资金已成功转入账户。

examples.en: The elder statesman's [advice] proved prophetic as events unfolded over the following decade.
examples.cn: 随着未来十年事件的发展，这位政治元老的[忠告]被证明是先见之明。

examples.en: The doctor [advised] her to rest for two weeks following the minor surgical procedure.
examples.cn: 医生[建议]她在小手术后休息两周。

examples.en: She was brought in to [advise] the government on its new digital economy strategy.
examples.cn: 她被聘来[为]政府[提供建议]，制定新的数字经济战略。

examples.en: Applicants will be [advised] of the outcome within ten working days of their interview.
examples.cn: 申请人将在面试后十个工作日内被[通知]结果。

examples.en: He was [advised] against making public statements until the investigation concluded.
examples.cn: 在调查结束前，他被[劝阻]公开发表声明。

examples.en: The senior researcher [advises] a group of doctoral students on their dissertation projects.
examples.cn: 这位高级研究员[指导]一组博士生完成其论文项目。

examples.en: Environmental groups [advocate] for stricter regulations on industrial pollution.
examples.cn: 环保团体[主张]对工业污染实施更严格的监管。

examples.en: She is a passionate [advocate] for gender equality in STEM fields.
examples.cn: 她是STEM领域性别平等的热忱[倡导者]。

examples.en: The defendant's [advocate] argued persuasively for a reduced sentence.
examples.cn: 被告的[辩护律师]就减轻刑罚进行了有力论证。

examples.en: Leading economists [advocated] a cautious approach to fiscal stimulus during the recession.
examples.cn: 顶尖经济学家在经济衰退期间[倡导]对财政刺激采取谨慎态度。

examples.en: The charity acts as an [advocate] for the rights of homeless families in the city.
examples.cn: 该慈善机构作为城市无家可归家庭权利的[倡导者]。

examples.en: The Wright brothers' [aeroplane] changed the history of human transportation forever.
examples.cn: 莱特兄弟的[飞机]永远改变了人类交通运输的历史。

examples.en: The [aeroplane] landed safely despite severe turbulence encountered during the flight.
examples.cn: 尽管飞行中遭遇强烈颠簸，[飞机]仍安全降落。

examples.en: Her [aeroplane] was delayed by three hours due to adverse weather conditions at the destination.
examples.cn: 由于目的地天气恶劣，她的[飞机]延误了三小时。

examples.en: Modern [aeroplanes] are far more fuel-efficient than those manufactured fifty years ago.
examples.cn: 现代[飞机]比五十年前制造的飞机燃油效率高得多。

examples.en: The museum displays [aeroplanes] from both World Wars alongside detailed historical exhibits.
examples.cn: 博物馆展示了两次世界大战的[飞机]，配以详细的历史展品。

examples.en: The management of foreign [affairs] requires extensive diplomatic experience and skill.
examples.cn: 外交[事务]的处理需要丰富的外交经验和技能。

examples.en: He insisted that his personal [affairs] were not a matter of public concern.
examples.cn: 他坚持认为自己的私人[事务]不是公众关心的事。

examples.en: The revelation of the politician's [affair] dominated the news cycle for weeks.
examples.cn: 政治家[婚外情]的曝光主导新闻周期长达数周。

examples.en: The annual charity gala is a glamorous [affair] attended by the city's leading figures.
examples.cn: 一年一度的慈善晚宴是一项由城市领袖人物参加的盛大[活动]。

examples.en: The diplomatic [affair] threatened to destabilise relations between the two neighbouring countries.
examples.cn: 这一外交[事件]威胁到两个邻国之间的关系稳定。

examples.en: Poor air quality [affects] the health of millions of people living in densely populated cities.
examples.cn: 恶劣的空气质量[影响]着生活在人口密集城市中数百万人的健康。

examples.en: The documentary [affected] her deeply and inspired her to pursue a career in conservation.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片[深深打动]了她，激励她投身环保事业。

examples.en: The disease [affects] mainly elderly people with weakened immune systems.
examples.cn: 这种疾病主要[侵袭]免疫系统较弱的老年人。

examples.en: He [affected] indifference to the criticism, but was clearly hurt by the remarks.
examples.cn: 他[假装]对批评无动于衷，但显然被那些评论所伤。

examples.en: The new tax regulations will [affect] both individuals and large corporations equally.
examples.cn: 新的税收法规将平等地[影响]个人和大型企业。

examples.en: She showed great [affection] for her students, often staying late to offer extra help.
examples.cn: 她对学生表现出极大的[情感]，经常留下来提供额外帮助。

examples.en: He expressed his [affection] for his partner through small but thoughtful gestures.
examples.cn: 他通过细小而体贴的举动表达对伴侣的[爱意]。

examples.en: The [affection] between the two old friends had endured over fifty years of separation.
examples.cn: 这两位老朋友之间的[情谊]经历了五十多年的分离依然如故。

examples.en: Growing up without parental [affection] can have long-lasting effects on a child's development.
examples.cn: 在缺乏父母[慈爱]的环境中成长，对孩子的发展可能有长远影响。

examples.en: The physician diagnosed a chronic [affection] of the respiratory system.
examples.cn: 医生诊断出一种慢性呼吸系统[疾患]。

examples.en: Many families in the region cannot [afford] nutritious food due to low income levels.
examples.cn: 由于收入水平低，该地区许多家庭[负担不起]营养食品。

examples.sense: v. 能承受；承担得起（代价）
examples.en: The company could not [afford] another product recall after last year's financial losses.
examples.cn: 经历去年的财务损失后，公司[承担不起]再次产品召回的代价。

examples.en: The new position [afforded] her the opportunity to travel extensively for research.
examples.cn: 新职位[给予]她大量出行进行研究的机会。

examples.en: With the deadline approaching, we can no longer [afford] to delay a decision.
examples.cn: 截止日期临近，我们再也[无法]延迟做出决定。

examples.en: Living near the sea [affords] residents spectacular views and fresh coastal air.
examples.cn: 临海居住[让]居民[享有]壮观的景色和清新的海岸空气。

examples.en: She was [afraid] of public speaking but forced herself to address the conference.
examples.cn: 她[害怕]公开演讲，但还是强迫自己在会议上发言。

examples.en: He was [afraid] that accepting the offer might compromise his professional integrity.
examples.cn: 他[担心]接受这个提议可能会损害自己的职业诚信。

examples.en: I'm [afraid] the project cannot be completed within the original budget.
examples.cn: [恐怕]项目无法在原定预算内完成。

examples.en: Many witnesses were [afraid] to come forward due to threats from the accused.
examples.cn: 由于被告的威胁，许多目击者[不敢]站出来作证。

examples.en: The whistleblower was [afraid] of the repercussions that might follow her disclosure.
examples.cn: 举报人[害怕]揭露后可能产生的后果。

examples.en: [Africa] is home to the world's largest desert, the Sahara, and its longest river, the Nile.
examples.cn: [非洲]拥有世界上最大的沙漠撒哈拉和最长的河流尼罗河。

examples.en: The biodiversity of [Africa]'s wildlife is unmatched anywhere else on the planet.
examples.cn: [非洲]野生动物的生物多样性举世无双。

examples.en: The scramble for [Africa] in the nineteenth century reshaped the continent's political boundaries.
examples.cn: 十九世纪列强瓜分[非洲]重塑了该大陆的政治边界。

examples.en: Many nations in [Africa] are experiencing rapid economic growth driven by technology investment.
examples.cn: [非洲]许多国家正经历由科技投资推动的快速经济增长。

examples.en: The oral storytelling traditions of [Africa] have preserved history across generations.
examples.cn: [非洲]的口述叙事传统跨越世代保存了历史。

examples.en: The exhibition showcased [African] art from over twenty different countries and traditions.
examples.cn: 展览展示了来自二十多个不同国家和传统的[非洲]艺术。

examples.en: Many [Africans] have made outstanding contributions to science, literature, and global culture.
examples.cn: 许多[非洲人]在科学、文学和全球文化方面作出了杰出贡献。

examples.sense: adj. 与非洲相关的（议题）
examples.en: [African] nations called for fairer representation in international financial institutions.
examples.cn: [非洲]国家呼吁在国际金融机构中获得更公平的代表权。

examples.en: The award-winning author drew on her [African] heritage to craft her celebrated novels.
examples.cn: 这位获奖作家从其[非洲]文化遗产中汲取灵感，创作了备受赞誉的小说。

examples.en: The [African] elephant is the largest land animal on Earth and an endangered species.
examples.cn: [非洲]象是地球上体型最大的陆地动物，也是濒危物种。

examples.en: Students should review their notes carefully [after] each lecture to reinforce their understanding.
examples.cn: 学生应在每次课[后]仔细回顾笔记，以巩固理解。

examples.en: [After] the experiment was completed, the team analysed the results for several weeks.
examples.cn: 实验完成[后]，团队花了数周时间分析结果。

examples.en: The detective suspected that the thieves were [after] the jewels stored in the museum vault.
examples.cn: 侦探怀疑窃贼是[图谋]存放在博物馆金库中的珠宝。

examples.en: The meeting was long and tedious; refreshments were served [after].
examples.cn: 会议漫长而乏味；[会后]提供了茶点。

examples.en: The building was named [after] a renowned scientist who had dedicated his life to research.
examples.cn: 这座建筑以一位献身研究的著名科学家[命名]。

examples.en: The committee is scheduled to meet [this afternoon] to discuss the revised proposal.
examples.cn: 委员会定于[今天下午]开会讨论修订后的提案。

examples.en: Spending a lazy [afternoon] at the botanical garden was her favourite weekend pastime.
examples.cn: 在植物园悠闲地度过一个[下午]是她最喜欢的周末消遣。

examples.en: The press conference will be held in the early [afternoon], following the morning session.
examples.cn: 新闻发布会将在上午会议结束后于[下午]早些时候举行。

examples.en: The café is usually quieter in the [afternoon] than during the busy morning rush hour.
examples.cn: 咖啡馆[下午]通常比繁忙的早高峰时段安静。

examples.sense: n. 黄金时代的晚期（比喻）
examples.en: Some scholars describe the late Renaissance as the [afternoon] of a great cultural era.
examples.cn: 一些学者将文艺复兴晚期描述为一个伟大文化时代的[下午]。

examples.en: The delegates signed the agreement and posed for photographs [afterward].
examples.cn: 代表们签署协议后[随即]合影留念。

examples.en: Only [afterward] did they realise the full significance of the breakthrough they had made.
examples.cn: 只有在[事后]，他们才意识到所取得突破的全部意义。

examples.en: The lecture lasted two hours; [afterward], students gathered to debate the key ideas.
examples.cn: 讲座持续了两个小时；[随后]，学生们聚在一起讨论核心观点。

examples.en: She left the company and [afterward] founded her own highly successful technology startup.
examples.cn: 她离开了公司，[后来]创立了自己极为成功的科技创业公司。

examples.en: The negotiators reached a tentative agreement; the details were formalised [afterward].
examples.cn: 谈判者达成了初步协议；细节[其后]得到正式确认。

examples.en: The experiment failed the first time, but the team succeeded [again] on the second attempt.
examples.cn: 实验第一次失败了，但团队在第二次尝试中[再次]成功。

examples.en: After months of rehabilitation, the athlete was able to compete [again] at the highest level.
examples.cn: 经过几个月的康复训练，运动员能够[重新]在最高水平上参赛。

examples.sense: adv. 另一方面；而且（then again）
examples.en: The proposal has merit; then [again], the costs may outweigh the potential benefits.
examples.cn: 该提案有可取之处；但[另一方面]，成本可能超过潜在收益。

examples.en: Despite his illness, he was [again] at his desk by Monday morning.
examples.cn: 尽管生病，他[还是]在周一早上回到了办公桌前。

examples.en: The renovation cost as much [again] as the original estimate due to unforeseen complications.
examples.cn: 由于意外复杂情况，翻新费用[再次]超出原估算额同等数量。

examples.en: Many scientists spoke out [against] the proposed cuts to research funding.
examples.cn: 许多科学家公开反对[削减]研究经费的提案。

examples.en: She leaned [against] the wall and considered her options carefully.
examples.cn: 她[靠]着墙，仔细考虑自己的选择。

examples.en: The new data must be assessed [against] the background of existing research.
examples.cn: 新数据必须对照现有研究背景进行[比对]评估。

examples.en: The national team will compete [against] last year's champions in the semifinal.
examples.cn: 国家队将在半决赛中[对阵]去年的冠军。

examples.en: The community built flood barriers [against] the threat of rising river levels.
examples.cn: 社区修建了防洪堤坝，[以防]河流水位上涨。

examples.en: Participation in the advanced programme is limited to students above the [age] of sixteen.
examples.cn: 参加高级课程的资格限于十六岁以上的学生。

examples.en: We are living in an [age] of rapid technological transformation and global connectivity.
examples.cn: 我们生活在一个快速技术变革和全球互联的[时代]。

examples.en: The monument had [aged] gracefully over the centuries, its grandeur undiminished.
examples.cn: 这座纪念碑历经数百年[岁月]沧桑，却风采依旧。

examples.en: With [age] comes wisdom, but also the need for greater health care and support.
examples.cn: 随着[年龄]的增长，人会变得更有智慧，但也需要更多的医疗保健和支持。

examples.en: Voting rights are granted to citizens who have reached the legal [age] of eighteen.
examples.cn: 公民达到法定[年龄]十八岁后即可享有投票权。

examples.en: A government [agency] was set up to oversee the implementation of environmental regulations.
examples.cn: 一个政府[机构]被设立起来监督环境法规的执行。

examples.en: She acted through a literary [agency] to negotiate the publication of her debut novel.
examples.cn: 她通过一家文学[代理机构]谈判出版了她的处女作。

examples.sense: n. 自主性；能动性（哲学）
examples.en: Human [agency] is the capacity to make free choices and act independently in the world.
examples.cn: 人的[能动性]是在世界中自由做出选择并独立行动的能力。

examples.en: Social change is often achieved through the [agency] of determined individuals and grassroots movements.
examples.cn: 社会变革往往通过坚定个人和基层运动的[推动]来实现。

examples.en: The multinational hired a top advertising [agency] to rebrand its global product line.
examples.cn: 这家跨国公司聘请了一家顶尖广告[代理公司]为其全球产品线重新定位。

examples.en: The [agenda] for tomorrow's board meeting covers five key items, including the budget review.
examples.cn: 明天董事会会议的[议程]涵盖五个关键事项，包括预算审查。

examples.en: The new administration's [agenda] focuses on healthcare reform and infrastructure development.
examples.cn: 新政府的[施政纲领]侧重于医疗改革和基础设施发展。

examples.sense: n. 隐藏意图；私心（hidden agenda）
examples.en: Critics suspected the proposal concealed a hidden [agenda] that served corporate rather than public interests.
examples.cn: 批评者怀疑该提案背后隐藏着服务企业而非公众利益的[私心]。

examples.sense: n. 优先事项；待办事项
examples.en: Tackling youth unemployment was at the top of the minister's [agenda] for the term.
examples.cn: 解决青年失业问题是部长本届任期[首要议题]。

examples.en: Climate change has risen to the top of the international scientific [agenda].
examples.cn: 气候变化已上升为国际科学[议程]的首要议题。

examples.en: The actor's [agent] negotiated a lucrative deal with the film studio on his behalf.
examples.cn: 演员的[经纪人]代其与电影公司谈妥了一笔丰厚的合约。

examples.en: The intelligence [agent] gathered critical information while operating undercover abroad.
examples.cn: 情报[特工]在海外卧底期间收集了关键信息。

examples.en: Bleach is an effective [agent] for disinfecting surfaces in medical environments.
examples.cn: 漂白剂是医疗环境中消毒表面的有效[制剂]。

examples.en: In this sentence, the subject is the [agent] that performs the action of the verb.
examples.cn: 在这个句子中，主语是执行动词动作的[施动者]。

examples.en: Education is one of the most powerful [agents] of social change in any society.
examples.cn: 教育是任何社会中最强大的社会变革[推动力]之一。

examples.en: The international community condemned the act of military [aggression] against the sovereign state.
examples.cn: 国际社会谴责对主权国家的军事[侵略]行为。

examples.en: Research suggests that certain environmental factors can increase [aggression] in adolescents.
examples.cn: 研究表明，某些环境因素会增加青少年的[攻击性]。

examples.en: The security guard was trained to de-escalate situations involving [aggression] from customers.
examples.cn: 保安人员接受了训练，以缓和顾客[攻击性]行为引发的局势。

examples.en: In competitive sports, controlled [aggression] can be a decisive advantage.
