examples.cn: 开演之夜大幕升起时，礼堂[洋溢]着兴奋之情。

examples.sense: adj. 有效的；仍在运作的
examples.en: The tradition has been kept [alive] by generations of craftsmen who refuse to let it die.
examples.cn: 这一传统被几代拒绝让其消亡的工匠[保持]活力。

examples.sense: adj. 警觉的；警觉到（alive to）
examples.en: Good leaders must remain [alive] to the changing needs of those they serve.
examples.cn: 优秀的领导者必须对其所服务的人群不断变化的需求保持[警觉]。

examples.en: [All] students are required to submit their assignments before the end of the semester.
examples.cn: [所有]学生须在学期结束前提交作业。

examples.en: The injured player was [all] but certain to miss the remainder of the season.
examples.cn: 受伤的球员[几乎]肯定会缺席本赛季的剩余比赛。

examples.en: She dedicated [all] her energy to completing the ambitious research project on time.
examples.cn: 她将[全部]精力投入到按时完成这个宏大研究项目中。

examples.en: The committee members [all] agreed that immediate action was necessary.
examples.cn: 委员会成员[一致]认为有必要立即采取行动。

examples.en: In the end, [all] that matters is the effort you put into the work.
examples.cn: 归根结底，重要的是你在工作中投入的[一切]努力。

examples.en: She is [allergic] to peanuts and always checks ingredient labels before eating packaged food.
examples.cn: 她对花生[过敏]，吃包装食品前总要检查成分标签。

examples.en: The [allergic] reaction to the medication required immediate medical attention.
examples.cn: 对药物的[过敏]反应需要立即就医。

examples.sense: adj. 对……极其反感的（口语）
examples.en: He seemed almost [allergic] to any form of physical exercise and preferred sedentary activities.
examples.cn: 他似乎对任何形式的体育锻炼几乎[极度反感]，更喜欢久坐的活动。

examples.en: The doctor recommended an [allergic] screening test to identify the cause of the rash.
examples.cn: 医生建议进行[过敏]筛查测试以确定皮疹的原因。

examples.en: People with [allergic] constitutions must take extra care during the spring pollen season.
examples.cn: [过敏]体质的人在春季花粉季节必须格外注意。

examples.en: The thieves escaped through a narrow [alley] behind the market, disappearing quickly.
examples.cn: 窃贼通过市场后面的一条狭窄[小巷]逃跑，很快消失了。

examples.en: The bowling [alley] was packed on Saturday night with families and groups of friends.
examples.cn: 周六晚上，保龄球[球道]挤满了家庭和朋友群。

examples.en: The garden featured a long [alley] of ancient oak trees leading to the manor house.
examples.cn: 花园里有一条通往庄园的长长的古橡树[林荫道]。

examples.en: The batter hit a powerful shot down the right [alley], earning a double.
examples.cn: 打击手打出一记强劲的右[区]安打，拿到二垒打。

examples.sense: n. 擅长领域（up one's alley）
examples.en: This project is right up her [alley] — it combines data analysis with environmental science.
examples.cn: 这个项目正合她的[胃口]——它结合了数据分析与环境科学。

examples.en: The committee decided to [allocate] additional funds to support underprivileged students.
examples.cn: 委员会决定[拨出]额外资金支持贫困学生。

examples.en: The project manager [allocated] specific responsibilities to each member of the team.
examples.cn: 项目经理向团队每个成员[分派]了具体职责。

examples.en: The government [allocated] a significant portion of the national budget to education.
examples.cn: 政府将国家预算的相当一部分[拨给]了教育领域。

examples.en: Thirty minutes were [allocated] for questions at the end of the presentation.
examples.cn: 演示结束后[留出]三十分钟用于提问。

examples.en: Shared costs were [allocated] proportionally based on each company's usage of the facility.
examples.cn: 共享成本根据每家公司对设施的使用情况按比例[分摊]。

examples.en: The school does not [allow] students to use mobile phones during lessons.
examples.cn: 学校不[允许]学生在上课期间使用手机。

examples.en: Please [allow] three to five working days for the delivery to arrive.
examples.cn: 请[预留]三到五个工作日等待货物送达。

examples.en: New satellite technology [allows] scientists to monitor deforestation in real time.
examples.cn: 新的卫星技术[使]科学家能够实时监测森林砍伐情况。

examples.en: The judge [allowed] that new evidence could be presented at the retrial.
examples.cn: 法官[允许]在重审时提交新证据。

examples.en: The architect [allowed] for potential future expansion when designing the building.
examples.cn: 建筑师在设计建筑时[留有]未来可能扩建的空间。

examples.en: His weekly [allowance] encouraged him to learn basic budgeting and financial management.
examples.cn: 每周的[零用钱]鼓励他学习基本的预算和财务管理。

examples.en: Employees posted overseas receive a generous cost-of-living [allowance].
examples.cn: 外派员工获得丰厚的生活费[补贴]。

examples.en: Each passenger is entitled to a luggage [allowance] of twenty-three kilograms.
examples.cn: 每位乘客有二十三公斤的行李[限额]。

examples.sense: n. 宽容；体谅（make allowance for）
examples.en: The examiner made [allowances] for candidates who were not native speakers of English.
examples.cn: 考官对非英语母语的考生作出了[宽限]。

examples.en: The shop gave her a generous trade-in [allowance] for the old appliance she returned.
examples.cn: 商店为她退回的旧电器给予了丰厚的折旧[折扣]。

examples.en: The project was [almost] complete when the funding was unexpectedly withdrawn.
examples.cn: 当资金意外撤回时，项目[几乎]已经完成。

examples.en: It took [almost] two hours to clear the queue at the customs checkpoint.
examples.cn: 在海关通关口排队花了[将近]两个小时。

examples.en: Her performance was [almost] flawless, earning her the highest score of the season.
examples.cn: 她的表演[几近]完美，为她赢得了本赛季的最高分。

examples.en: He [almost] missed the deadline but submitted his application with minutes to spare.
examples.cn: 他[差点]错过截止日期，但还是在最后几分钟内提交了申请。

examples.en: The scientist had achieved [almost] the impossible with her groundbreaking experiment.
examples.cn: 这位科学家的开创性实验[几乎]实现了不可能的事情。

examples.en: She preferred to work [alone] rather than in a group when tackling complex problems.
examples.cn: 在处理复杂问题时，她更喜欢[独自]工作而不是在小组中。

examples.en: Living far from family, he often felt utterly [alone] in the crowded city.
examples.cn: 远离家人生活，他在这个拥挤的城市里常常感到完全[孤独]。

examples.en: The cost [alone] should be enough reason to reconsider the proposal.
examples.cn: [仅]成本一项就应该足以重新考虑这个提案。

examples.en: She [alone] possessed the knowledge needed to solve the mysterious code.
examples.cn: [唯有]她具备解开神秘密码所需的知识。

examples.en: The researcher urged policymakers to leave the fragile ecosystem [alone].
examples.cn: 研究人员敦促政策制定者不要干预这个脆弱的生态系统。

examples.en: Cyclists enjoy riding [along] the scenic coastal path that stretches for twenty kilometres.
examples.cn: 骑行者喜欢沿着延伸二十公里的风景优美的海岸小径骑行。

examples.en: The convoy moved [along] steadily despite the difficult mountain terrain.
examples.cn: 尽管山地地形艰难，车队仍稳步[前进]。

examples.en: Would you like to come [along] to the conference next week?
examples.cn: 你下周想[一起]来参加会议吗？

examples.en: Trees were planted [along] both sides of the new boulevard to provide shade.
examples.cn: 在新林荫大道两侧[沿途]种植了树木以提供荫凉。

examples.en: The answer had been right there [all along], hidden in plain sight.
examples.cn: 答案[一直]就在那里，就在众目睽睽之下。

examples.en: The small fishing boats were moored [alongside] the larger cargo vessel in the harbour.
examples.cn: 小渔船停靠在港口较大货船[旁边]。

examples.en: Local volunteers worked [alongside] professional relief workers during the disaster response.
examples.cn: 当地志愿者在灾难救援期间与专业救援人员[并肩]工作。

examples.en: The new initiative was developed [alongside] existing programmes rather than replacing them.
examples.cn: 新举措是与现有项目[并行]开发的，而不是取代它们。

examples.en: When considered [alongside] global benchmarks, the country's progress is impressive.
examples.cn: 与全球基准[相比照]，该国的进步令人印象深刻。

examples.en: Technology should complement [alongside] human creativity, not replace it entirely.
examples.cn: 技术应与人类创造力[相辅相成]，而不是完全取代它。

examples.en: Reading [aloud] is an effective technique for improving pronunciation and fluency.
examples.cn: [大声]朗读是提高发音和流利度的有效技巧。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to read the passage [aloud] so she could assess their pronunciation.
examples.cn: 老师要求学生[朗读]这段文字，以便她评估他们的发音。

examples.en: She thought [aloud], musing over the problem without fully realising she was being heard.
examples.cn: 她[自言自语]，思考着问题，没有意识到有人在听她说话。

examples.en: He dared to think [aloud] about restructuring the company in front of the board.
examples.cn: 他敢于在董事会面前[公开]说出关于重组公司的想法。

examples.sense: adv. 高声（以便他人听见）
examples.en: The guide asked visitors to speak [aloud] so that everyone in the tour group could hear.
examples.cn: 导游要求游客[大声]说话，以便旅游团中的每个人都能听到。

examples.en: The Roman [alphabet] is used as the basis for writing in most European languages.
examples.cn: 罗马[字母表]是大多数欧洲语言书写的基础。

examples.en: Learning the [alphabet] is the first step for any child beginning to read and write.
examples.cn: 学习[字母表]是任何孩子开始读写的第一步。

examples.en: The entries in the dictionary are arranged in [alphabetical] order for easy reference.
examples.cn: 词典中的条目按[字母]顺序排列，便于查阅。

examples.en: The Arabic [alphabet] is written from right to left and consists of twenty-eight letters.
examples.cn: 阿拉伯[字母表]从右向左书写，由二十八个字母组成。

examples.en: Understanding the [alphabet] of financial investing takes months of dedicated study.
examples.cn: 了解金融投资的[基础知识]需要数月的专注学习。

examples.en: By the time the reinforcements arrived, the rescue team had [already] located the survivors.
examples.cn: 援军到达时，救援队[已经]找到了幸存者。

examples.sense: adv. 这么早；如此之快（表惊讶）
examples.en: It's eight o'clock [already] — we need to leave immediately if we want to catch the train.
examples.cn: [已经]八点了——如果我们想赶上火车，需要立即出发。

examples.en: She had [already] prepared a thorough response before the journalist posed the question.
examples.cn: 在记者提问之前，她[已经]准备好了详尽的回答。

examples.sense: adv. 在此之前（过去完成）
examples.en: The researchers [had already] published their preliminary findings before the final results were confirmed.
examples.cn: 研究人员在最终结果得到确认之前[已经]发表了初步研究结果。

examples.sense: adv. 够了；就行了（表不耐烦）
examples.en: That is [already] more information than we need to make a decision.
examples.cn: 这[已经]比我们做决定所需的信息还要多了。

examples.en: She is not only a talented researcher but [also] an accomplished public speaker.
examples.cn: 她不仅是一位才华横溢的研究人员，[也]是一位出色的公众演讲者。

examples.en: The conference addressed economic development and [also] touched on environmental sustainability.
examples.cn: 会议讨论了经济发展，[也]涉及了环境可持续性。

examples.sense: adv. 除此之外（补充信息）
examples.en: He speaks French fluently and [also] has a working knowledge of Spanish and Italian.
examples.cn: 他能流利地说法语，[此外]还具备西班牙语和意大利语的应用能力。

examples.en: The new policy will benefit large corporations, but it should [also] support smaller businesses.
examples.cn: 新政策将使大型企业受益，但[也]应该支持中小型企业。

examples.en: The museum is [also] a research centre, conducting scientific studies on its collections.
examples.cn: 该博物馆[同时]也是一个研究中心，对其馆藏进行科学研究。

examples.sense: n. 替代选择；备选方案
examples.en: Renewable energy offers a viable [alternative] to fossil fuels for powering the global economy.
examples.cn: 可再生能源为化石燃料提供了一个可行的[替代选择]，用于驱动全球经济。

examples.sense: adj. 另外的；可供选择的
examples.en: The detour provided an [alternative] route when the main road was blocked by flooding.
examples.cn: 当主干道因洪水封堵时，绕行路提供了一条[备用]路线。

examples.en: She pursued an [alternative] lifestyle, rejecting the conventional path of corporate employment.
examples.cn: 她追求[另类]的生活方式，拒绝了传统的企业就业道路。

examples.en: The committee was faced with a stark [alternative]: accept the terms or withdraw from the deal.
examples.cn: 委员会面临一个严峻的[抉择]：接受条款或退出交易。

examples.en: Many patients explore [alternative] therapies alongside conventional medical treatment.
examples.cn: 许多患者在接受传统医疗的同时探索[替代性]疗法。

examples.en: [Although] the experiment failed initially, the researchers refused to abandon the project.
examples.cn: [尽管]实验最初失败了，研究人员还是拒绝放弃这个项目。

examples.en: The film received critical acclaim, [although] it performed modestly at the box office.
examples.cn: 这部电影获得了评论界的好评，[但]票房表现却较为普通。

examples.en: [Although] exhausted after the long journey, she attended the welcome dinner without complaint.
examples.cn: [虽然]长途跋涉后已精疲力竭，她还是毫无怨言地参加了欢迎晚宴。

examples.en: The new policy has its drawbacks, [although] on balance it represents genuine progress.
examples.cn: 新政策有其缺点，[不过]总体而言，它代表了真正的进步。

examples.en: [Although] opinions differ on the best approach, most experts agree on the urgency of the problem.
examples.cn: [尽管]在最佳方法上存在分歧，但大多数专家都同意问题的紧迫性。

examples.en: At high [altitude], the reduced oxygen levels make physical exertion more demanding.
examples.cn: 在高[海拔]地区，减少的氧气含量使体力消耗更为困难。

examples.en: The pilot maintained a cruising [altitude] of thirty-five thousand feet above sea level.
examples.cn: 飞行员保持着海平面以上三万五千英尺的巡航[高度]。

examples.en: The ancient monastery was built at a considerable [altitude] to isolate it from the outside world.
examples.cn: 这座古老的寺院建在相当高的[海拔]处，与外界相隔绝。

examples.en: The [altitude] of the sun at noon varies depending on the observer's latitude.
examples.cn: 正午太阳的[仰角]因观测者所处纬度不同而有所差异。

examples.en: Her novel reached a new [altitude] of literary achievement with its intricate narrative structure.
examples.cn: 她的小说凭借其复杂的叙事结构达到了文学成就的新[高度]。

examples.en: The committee rejected the proposal [altogether], citing insufficient evidence to support it.
examples.cn: 委员会以证据不足为由，[完全]否决了该提案。

examples.en: [Altogether], the project employed over two hundred engineers and specialists.
examples.cn: [总共]，该项目雇用了两百多名工程师和专家。

examples.sense: adv. 总体而言；综合来看
examples.en: [Altogether], the reforms have had a positive impact on the country's economic competitiveness.
examples.cn: [总体而言]，这些改革对该国的经济竞争力产生了积极影响。

examples.en: The situation is not [altogether] hopeless — there are still viable solutions to explore.
examples.cn: 情况并[非完全]无望——仍有可行的解决方案值得探索。

examples.en: The five departments worked [altogether] to produce the comprehensive annual report.
examples.cn: 五个部门[共同]合作，完成了详尽的年度报告。

examples.en: [Aluminium] is widely used in the aerospace industry due to its strength and low weight.
examples.cn: [铝]因其强度高、重量轻的特点被广泛应用于航空航天工业。

examples.en: Recycling [aluminium] requires only five percent of the energy needed to produce it from raw ore.
examples.cn: 回收[铝]所需能源仅为从原矿提炼所需能源的5%。

examples.en: Many modern vehicles use [aluminium] components to reduce overall weight and improve fuel efficiency.
examples.cn: 许多现代汽车使用[铝]合金零部件以减轻整体重量并提高燃油效率。

examples.en: The cooking pots were made of [aluminium], which conducts heat quickly and evenly.
examples.cn: 这些炊具由[铝]制成，导热快而均匀。

examples.en: [Aluminium] has the atomic number thirteen and is the most abundant metal in the Earth's crust.
examples.cn: [铝]的原子序数为13，是地壳中含量最丰富的金属。

examples.en: She [always] arrives at work fifteen minutes early to prepare for the day ahead.
examples.cn: 她[总是]提前十五分钟到达工作单位，为接下来的一天做准备。

examples.en: The principles of scientific inquiry have [always] demanded rigour, honesty, and repeatability.
examples.cn: 科学探究的原则[始终]要求严谨、诚实和可重复性。

examples.sense: adv. 不断地；不停地（表强调）
examples.en: He is [always] finding fault with the team's approach rather than offering constructive solutions.
examples.cn: 他[不断]挑剔团队的方法，而不是提出建设性的解决方案。

examples.en: If the interview goes badly, you can [always] apply for the position again next year.
examples.cn: 如果面试结果不好，你[总可以]明年再次申请这个职位。

examples.en: The institution has [always] been committed to the pursuit of academic excellence.
examples.cn: 该机构[历来]致力于追求学术卓越。

examples.en: The emergency meeting was scheduled for nine [AM], before the markets opened.
examples.cn: 紧急会议定于上午九时[AM]举行，在市场开市之前。

examples.en: The [AM] radio broadcast could be received across the entire region on clear nights.
examples.cn: 晴朗的夜晚，整个地区都能收到[调幅]广播信号。

examples.en: Flights departing at three [AM] require passengers to arrive at the airport by one in the morning.
examples.cn: 凌晨三时起飞的航班要求乘客在上午一时到达机场。

examples.en: She earned her [AM] degree in History from a prestigious university before pursuing her doctorate.
examples.cn: 她在攻读博士学位之前，在一所著名大学获得了历史学[文学硕士]学位。

examples.en: I [am] convinced that consistent effort is the foundation of any meaningful achievement.
examples.cn: 我[坚信]持续努力是任何有意义成就的基础。

examples.en: He is a passionate [amateur] photographer whose work has been exhibited in several galleries.
examples.cn: 他是一位热忱的[业余]摄影爱好者，其作品已在多个画廊展出。

examples.en: The [amateur] theatre production received surprisingly enthusiastic reviews from local critics.
examples.cn: 这部[业余]剧场演出出乎意料地获得了当地评论家的热情好评。

examples.en: The committee was criticised for hiring [amateurs] to manage a project of such complexity.
examples.cn: 委员会因聘用[外行人]管理如此复杂的项目而受到批评。

examples.en: Despite its [amateur] production quality, the documentary conveyed a powerful message.
examples.cn: 尽管制作质量[业余]，但这部纪录片传达了强有力的信息。

examples.sense: n. 参赛的非职业选手
examples.en: The marathon includes both professional and [amateur] runners competing on the same course.
examples.cn: 这场马拉松比赛有职业跑者和[业余]跑者在同一赛道上竞技。

examples.en: The acrobat's breathtaking performance [amazed] the audience from the very first moment.
examples.cn: 杂技演员令人屏息的表演从第一刻起便令观众[叹为观止]。

examples.en: It continues to [amaze] me how quickly children can adapt to new languages.
examples.cn: 孩子们适应新语言的速度之快至今仍让我[惊叹]。

examples.en: The scale of the archaeological discovery [amazed] even the most experienced researchers.
examples.cn: 考古发现的规模令最有经验的研究人员也[大为惊叹]。

examples.en: Her courage in speaking out against injustice [amazed] those who had considered her timid.
examples.cn: 她勇于挺身反对不公正的勇气，令那些认为她胆怯的人[大为惊叹]。

examples.en: The speed at which the technology has developed has continued to [amaze] industry experts.
examples.cn: 技术发展的速度持续令业内专家[惊讶不已]。

examples.sense: adj. 令人惊叹的；不可思议的
examples.en: The [amazing] diversity of life in the ocean depths continues to astonish marine biologists.
examples.cn: 深海中[令人惊叹]的生命多样性持续令海洋生物学家惊叹。

examples.sense: adj. 极好的；出色的（口语）
examples.en: She gave an [amazing] presentation that held the entire conference's attention for an hour.
examples.cn: 她作了一场[精彩绝伦]的演示，吸引了整个会议的注意力长达一小时。

examples.sense: adj. 不可思议的；难以置信的
examples.en: It is [amazing] how much scientific knowledge has been accumulated in the past century.
examples.cn: 过去一个世纪积累了如此多的科学知识，[令人难以置信]。

examples.en: Her [amazing] memory allowed her to recite entire chapters of the textbook from memory.
examples.cn: 她[惊人]的记忆力使她能够凭记忆背诵整章教材。

examples.en: It is [amazing] that such a small team managed to complete the project ahead of schedule.
examples.cn: 如此小的团队竟能提前完成项目，真是[令人惊叹]。

examples.en: The [ambassador] presented his credentials to the head of state upon his arrival in the capital.
examples.cn: [大使]抵达首都后向国家元首递交了国书。

examples.en: She has served as a goodwill [ambassador] for the United Nations since her retirement from sport.
examples.cn: 自从退出体育界以来，她一直担任联合国的亲善[大使]。

examples.sense: n. 形象代言人；倡导者
examples.en: The celebrity [ambassador] helped raise awareness of the charity's work among younger audiences.
examples.cn: 名人[形象大使]帮助在年轻受众中提高了对慈善工作的认知度。

examples.en: The [ambassadors] from all fifteen member states attended the emergency summit in Vienna.
examples.cn: 全部十五个成员国的[大使]出席了在维也纳举行的紧急峰会。

examples.en: The sports brand signed the Olympic champion as their global [ambassador] for three years.
examples.cn: 这家运动品牌签约奥运冠军担任其三年的全球[品牌大使]。

examples.en: The contract's [ambiguous] wording led to a prolonged legal dispute between the two parties.
examples.cn: 合同中[模糊]的措辞导致双方之间长期的法律纠纷。

examples.sense: adj. 不明确的；意义不清的
examples.en: The politician gave an [ambiguous] answer that satisfied neither supporters nor critics.
examples.cn: 这位政治家给出了一个[模棱两可]的答案，既未满足支持者也未满足批评者。

examples.sense: adj. 两可的；双重意义的
examples.en: The title of the novel is deliberately [ambiguous], suggesting multiple interpretations.
examples.cn: 这部小说的书名是故意[模糊]的，暗示着多种解读方式。

examples.sense: adj. 不确定的；难以判断的
examples.en: The medical test results were [ambiguous] and required further investigation.
examples.cn: 医学检测结果[不明确]，需要进一步调查。

examples.en: In academic writing, [ambiguous] pronoun references should always be clarified for precision.
examples.cn: 在学术写作中，[含糊]的代词指代应始终明确以保证精确性。

examples.en: Her [ambition] to become a leading neuroscientist drove her to pursue postgraduate research.
examples.cn: 她成为顶尖神经科学家的[雄心]驱使她攻读研究生学位。

examples.en: His childhood [ambition] was to design aeroplanes, and he never wavered from that dream.
examples.cn: 他童年的[理想]是设计飞机，他从未动摇过那个梦想。

examples.en: Unchecked [ambition] can lead talented individuals to compromise their ethical principles.
examples.cn: 不受约束的[野心]可能导致有才华的个人妥协其道德原则。

examples.en: The organisation's [ambition] is to eradicate preventable diseases in developing nations.
examples.cn: 该组织的[志向]是消除发展中国家的可预防疾病。

examples.en: Students who lack [ambition] may underperform regardless of their natural academic ability.
examples.cn: 缺乏[进取心]的学生无论天生学术能力如何，都可能表现不佳。

examples.en: Bystanders cleared the road immediately so the [ambulance] could reach the scene faster.
examples.cn: 旁观者立即清空道路，以便[救护车]能更快到达现场。

examples.en: The [ambulance] crew provided first aid during the twenty-minute journey to the hospital.
examples.cn: [救护车]人员在二十分钟的送院途中提供了急救处理。

examples.sense: n. 急救医疗服务（广义）
examples.en: Calling an [ambulance] promptly can make the difference between life and death in a stroke.
examples.cn: 在中风时及时呼叫[救护车]可能关系到生死存亡。

examples.en: Florence Nightingale pioneered the use of mobile [ambulance] units during the Crimean War.
examples.cn: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔在克里米亚战争期间率先使用了移动[救护]车队。

examples.en: The [ambulance] team worked tirelessly to stabilise the injured victims at the crash site.
examples.cn: [救护]队员在事故现场不遗余力地稳定伤者的伤情。

examples.en: Silicon Valley in [America] is recognised as the global hub of technology innovation.
examples.cn: [美国]的硅谷被公认为全球技术创新中心。

examples.en: Christopher Columbus reached [America] in 1492, transforming global history.
examples.cn: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布于1492年到达[美洲]，改变了世界历史。

examples.en: Jazz music originated in [America] and has since influenced musical traditions worldwide.
examples.cn: 爵士乐起源于[美国]，此后影响了世界各地的音乐传统。

examples.en: The native peoples of [America] developed sophisticated civilisations long before European contact.
examples.cn: [美洲]的原住民在与欧洲人接触之前很久便建立了高度发展的文明。

examples.en: The debate over gun control remains one of the most divisive issues in [America] today.
examples.cn: 枪支管制争论至今仍是[美国]社会中最具争议的问题之一。

examples.en: The [American] dream of social mobility through hard work continues to attract immigrants.
examples.cn: 通过努力工作实现社会流动的[美国]梦想持续吸引着移民。

examples.en: Many [Americans] voted for the first time in decades, energised by the pivotal election issues.
examples.cn: 许多[美国人]受到关键选举议题的激励，数十年来首次投票。

examples.en: [American] bison were nearly hunted to extinction before conservation efforts saved the species.
examples.cn: [美洲]野牛在保护工作拯救该物种之前几乎被猎杀至灭绝。

examples.en: The spread of [American] fast food and popular culture has transformed urban life globally.
examples.cn: [美国]快餐和流行文化的传播已在全球范围内改变了城市生活。

examples.en: The constitution guarantees fundamental rights to all [Americans], regardless of background.
examples.cn: 宪法保障所有[美国公民]的基本权利，不论其背景如何。

examples.en: [Among] the candidates, she was considered the most qualified for the senior position.
examples.cn: 在所有候选人[中]，她被认为是最符合高级职位资格的。

examples.en: The responsibilities were divided [among] the five team members according to their expertise.
examples.cn: 责任根据各自专长在五名团队成员[之间]分配。

examples.en: Renewable energy is [among] the fastest-growing sectors of the global economy.
examples.cn: 可再生能源[属于]全球经济增长最快的行业之一。

examples.en: There was considerable disagreement [among] delegates about the proposed resolution.
examples.cn: 代表们[之间]对拟议决议存在相当大的分歧。

examples.en: The nations agreed [among] themselves to establish a joint defence treaty.
examples.cn: 各国[相互]同意建立联合防御条约。

examples.en: The [amount] of plastic waste entering the ocean each year is staggering.
examples.cn: 每年进入海洋的塑料垃圾[数量]令人震惊。

examples.en: The total [amount] donated to the charity exceeded two million pounds last year.
examples.cn: 去年捐给该慈善机构的总[金额]超过了两百万英镑。

examples.en: The additional charges [amount] to a significant increase in the overall cost.
examples.cn: 这些额外费用[总计]相当于整体成本的大幅增加。

examples.en: Refusing to cooperate with the investigation [amounts] to an obstruction of justice.
examples.cn: 拒绝配合调查[等同于]妨碍司法公正。

examples.en: No [amount] of persuasion could convince him to change his firmly held position.
examples.cn: 无论多少[程度]的劝说都无法说服他改变其坚定的立场。

examples.en: There is [ample] evidence to support the conclusion that global temperatures are rising.
examples.cn: 有[充足]的证据支持全球气温正在上升的结论。

examples.en: The new campus provides [ample] space for research laboratories, lecture halls, and student accommodation.
examples.cn: 新校园为研究实验室、讲堂和学生住宿提供了[宽裕]的空间。

examples.en: She had [ample] time to prepare her presentation thoroughly before the board meeting.
examples.cn: 她有[充裕]的时间在董事会议前彻底准备她的演示。

examples.sense: adj. 宽大的；肥大的（体型）
examples.en: The [ample] proportions of the building reflected the grand ambitions of its original designers.
examples.cn: 建筑的[宽大]比例体现了其原始设计者的宏大抱负。

examples.en: The budget allocated for the project proved [ample] to cover all expected and unforeseen costs.
examples.cn: 为项目分配的预算被证明[绰绰有余]，足以覆盖所有预期和意外成本。

examples.en: The comedian's witty observations about everyday life [amused] the entire audience.
examples.cn: 喜剧演员对日常生活的机智评论[逗乐]了全场观众。

examples.sense: v. 消遣；使（某人）有事可做
examples.en: She [amused] herself during the long flight by reading and listening to podcasts.
examples.cn: 她在漫长的飞行中通过阅读和收听播客来[消遣]。

examples.en: The irony of the situation [amused] her, though she tried not to show it openly.
examples.cn: 这种情况的讽刺意味令她感到[好笑]，尽管她努力不表现出来。

examples.en: Children should be encouraged to [amuse] themselves creatively rather than relying on screens.
examples.cn: 应鼓励孩子们以创造性的方式[自娱]，而不是依赖电子屏幕。

examples.en: His attempts to fix the machine [amused] his colleagues, who could see the obvious solution.
examples.cn: 他修机器的尝试[逗乐]了同事们，他们一眼就看出了显而易见的解决方法。

examples.en: Reading detective novels is his favourite [amusement] during long business trips.
examples.cn: 阅读侦探小说是他漫长出差途中最喜欢的[消遣]。

examples.en: To everyone's [amusement], the formal speech turned into an unexpectedly humorous story.
examples.cn: 令所有人[忍俊不禁]的是，这篇正式演讲意外地变成了一个幽默故事。

examples.sense: n. 娱乐设施；游乐活动
examples.en: The theme park offers a wide variety of [amusements] suitable for all age groups.
examples.cn: 主题公园提供各种适合所有年龄段的[娱乐]活动。

examples.en: She watched with quiet [amusement] as her students struggled with the deliberately tricky puzzle.
examples.cn: 她以平静的[愉悦]看着学生们费力应对那道故意设计得棘手的谜题。

examples.en: The village fair provided simple [amusements] that brought the community together each summer.
examples.cn: 村庄集市每年夏天提供简单的[娱乐活动]，将社区成员聚集在一起。

examples.en: A detailed [analysis] of the data revealed unexpected patterns in consumer behaviour.
examples.cn: 对数据的详细[分析]揭示了消费者行为中意想不到的规律。

examples.sense: n. 化学分析；成分分析
examples.en: Laboratory [analysis] confirmed that the water sample contained unsafe levels of lead.
examples.cn: 实验室[分析]证实，水样含有不安全的铅含量。

examples.sense: n. 心理分析（精神分析）
examples.en: After years of [analysis], she gained a clearer understanding of the root causes of her anxiety.
examples.cn: 经过多年的[分析]，她对自己焦虑的根本原因有了更清晰的认识。

examples.en: The literary [analysis] examined the novel's use of symbolism and narrative structure.
examples.cn: 这篇文学[分析]研究了小说对象征主义和叙事结构的运用。

examples.en: In the final [analysis], the success of the project depended on the commitment of the entire team.
examples.cn: [归根结底]，项目的成功取决于整个团队的投入。

examples.en: Scientists [analyze] vast amounts of atmospheric data to track climate patterns.
examples.cn: 科学家[分析]大量大气数据以追踪气候规律。

examples.en: The economist was asked to [analyze] the impact of the new trade policies on domestic industries.
examples.cn: 经济学家被要求[分析]新贸易政策对国内产业的影响。

examples.en: Students were asked to [analyze] the rhetorical techniques used in the political speech.
examples.cn: 要求学生[分析]政治演讲中使用的修辞技巧。

examples.en: The laboratory will [analyze] the soil samples to determine their chemical composition.
examples.cn: 实验室将[分析]土壤样本以确定其化学成分。

examples.en: Before making a decision, it is always wise to [analyze] the potential risks involved.
examples.cn: 在做决定之前，[分析]可能涉及的潜在风险始终是明智之举。

examples.en: Many people research their family history to learn more about the lives of their [ancestors].
examples.cn: 许多人研究家族历史以进一步了解[祖先]的生活。

examples.en: The abacus is considered an [ancestor] of the modern electronic computer.
examples.cn: 算盘被认为是现代电子计算机的[鼻祖]。

examples.en: Our [ancestors] depended entirely on nature for food, shelter, and medicine.
examples.cn: 我们的[祖先]完全依赖自然获取食物、庇护所和药物。

examples.en: The steam engine was the [ancestor] of most modern industrial machinery.
examples.cn: 蒸汽机是大多数现代工业机械的[前身]。

examples.en: Homo sapiens shares a common [ancestor] with chimpanzees, according to evolutionary biology.
examples.cn: 根据进化生物学，智人与黑猩猩拥有共同的[祖先]。

examples.en: The [ancient] civilisations of Egypt, Greece, and Rome laid the foundations of Western culture.
examples.cn: 埃及、希腊和罗马的[古代]文明奠定了西方文化的基础。

examples.sense: adj. 古老的；年代久远的
examples.en: The [ancient] manuscripts were carefully preserved in a climate-controlled archive.
examples.cn: 这些[古老]的手稿被保存在一个恒温控制的档案馆中。

examples.sense: adj. 极老的；非常古旧的（口语）
examples.en: Her [ancient] laptop takes fifteen minutes to start up and crashes regularly.
examples.cn: 她那台[极其老旧]的笔记本电脑启动需要十五分钟，还经常崩溃。

examples.en: [Ancient] Greek philosophy continues to influence modern ethical and political thought.
examples.cn: [古希腊]哲学继续影响着现代伦理和政治思想。

examples.en: Some critics dismissed the proposal as [ancient] thinking that ignored contemporary realities.
examples.cn: 一些批评者将该提案斥为无视当代现实的[陈旧]思想。

examples.en: Science [and] the humanities are complementary fields that together enrich human understanding.
examples.cn: 科学[与]人文学科是相互补充的领域，共同丰富了人类的认知。

examples.en: She completed her undergraduate degree [and] immediately enrolled in a master's programme.
examples.cn: 她完成了本科学位，[然后]立即攻读硕士课程。

examples.en: The project requires financial investment [and] considerable technical expertise to succeed.
examples.cn: 该项目需要财务投资[并且]需要相当的技术专业知识才能成功。

examples.en: Work consistently every day [and] you will see measurable improvements within months.
examples.cn: 每天坚持工作，[那么]你将在几个月内看到可量化的进步。

examples.en: The problem is complex [and] yet surprisingly simple to solve with the right framework.
examples.cn: 这个问题很复杂，[然而]用正确的框架却出乎意料地简单易解。

examples.en: The professor opened his lecture with a humorous [anecdote] about a famous physicist's mistake.
examples.cn: 教授以一则关于一位著名物理学家失误的幽默[轶事]开始了他的讲座。

examples.en: Her speech was filled with personal [anecdotes] that made the abstract concepts feel relatable.
examples.cn: 她的演讲充满了个人[趣闻]，使抽象概念变得贴近生活。

examples.sense: n. 个案（区别于统计数据）
examples.en: A single [anecdote] is not sufficient to draw reliable conclusions about a broader phenomenon.
examples.cn: 单一的[个案]不足以对更广泛的现象得出可靠结论。

examples.en: The biography is rich with [anecdotes] that reveal the statesman's private personality.
examples.cn: 这部传记充满了揭示这位政治家私人性格的[轶事]。

examples.en: The [anecdote] about Newton and the apple, though probably apocryphal, has endured for centuries.
examples.cn: 关于牛顿和苹果的[轶事]虽然可能是杜撰的，但已流传了数百年。

examples.en: He channelled his [anger] at injustice into writing a powerful political essay.
examples.cn: 他将对不公正的[愤怒]化为动力，写出了一篇有力的政治文章。

examples.en: The misleading report [angered] many scientists who questioned its accuracy.
examples.cn: 这篇误导性的报告[激怒]了许多质疑其准确性的科学家。

examples.en: Public [anger] over the government's handling of the crisis intensified daily.
examples.cn: 公众对政府处理危机方式的[愤怒]每天都在加剧。

examples.en: She concealed her [anger] behind a calm exterior during the contentious board meeting.
examples.cn: 她在争议性的董事会议上用平静的外表掩盖了内心的[恼怒]。

examples.en: The [anger] of the displaced community finally pushed local authorities to act.
examples.cn: 被迁移社区的[激愤]最终迫使地方当局采取行动。

examples.en: The photographer chose an unusual [angle] to capture the grandeur of the cathedral.
examples.cn: 摄影师选择了一个不寻常的[角度]来捕捉大教堂的宏伟。

examples.en: The documentary explored the conflict from the [angle] of ordinary citizens affected by it.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片从受其影响的普通公民的[视角]探讨了这场冲突。

examples.en: The interior [angles] of a triangle always sum to one hundred and eighty degrees.
examples.cn: 三角形的内[角]之和始终等于一百八十度。

examples.en: The surgeon [angled] the instrument carefully to avoid damaging the surrounding tissue.
examples.cn: 外科医生小心地[倾斜]手术器械，以避免损伤周围组织。

examples.sense: v. 别有用心地写（angle for）
examples.en: The journalist was accused of [angling] her article to support a particular political agenda.
examples.cn: 这位记者被指责故意[歪曲]文章立场以支持特定政治议程。

examples.en: She was deeply [angry] at the blatant disregard for environmental regulations.
examples.cn: 她对公然漠视环境法规的行为感到[深深愤怒]。

examples.sense: adj. 激烈的；情绪激动的
examples.en: The [angry] exchange during the debate reflected deep divisions within the party.
examples.cn: 辩论中[激烈]的交锋反映了党内的深层分裂。

examples.en: The fishing boats struggled against the [angry] sea as the storm worsened.
examples.cn: 随着风暴加剧，渔船在[汹涌]的海浪中挣扎。

examples.sense: adj. 红肿的；炎症的（伤口）
examples.en: The wound looked [angry] and infected, requiring immediate antibiotic treatment.
examples.cn: 伤口看起来[红肿]感染，需要立即进行抗生素治疗。

examples.en: He wrote an [angry] letter to the newspaper condemning the government's inaction.
examples.cn: 他给报纸写了一封[愤怒]的信，谴责政府的不作为。

examples.en: The conservation programme aims to protect [animals] facing extinction in their natural habitats.
examples.cn: 该保护项目旨在保护在自然栖息地面临灭绝的[动物]。

examples.sense: n. 哺乳动物（区别于昆虫等）
examples.en: Mammals are warm-blooded [animals] that give birth to live young and nurse them with milk.
examples.cn: 哺乳动物是温血[动物]，胎生并用乳汁哺育幼崽。

examples.en: Working conditions in the factory were described as fit only for [animals], not human beings.
examples.cn: 工厂的工作条件被描述为只适合[牲畜]，而非人类。

examples.en: He suppressed his [animal] instincts and responded with calculated calm.
examples.cn: 他压制了[本能]的冲动，以经过深思熟虑的冷静作出回应。

examples.sense: n. 生物（哲学、生物学广义）
examples.en: Aristotle classified humans as rational [animals], distinct from other creatures by reason.
examples.cn: 亚里士多德将人类归类为理性[动物]，以理性区别于其他生物。

examples.en: She twisted her [ankle] during training and was unable to compete in the championship.
examples.cn: 她在训练中扭伤了[脚踝]，无法参加锦标赛。

examples.en: The physiotherapist designed a rehabilitation programme to strengthen the injured [ankle].
examples.cn: 理疗师设计了一套康复方案来强化受伤的[踝关节]。

examples.en: She wore a delicate bracelet around her [ankle] that jingled softly as she walked.
examples.cn: 她的[脚踝]上戴着一个精致的脚链，走路时轻轻叮当作响。

examples.en: The floodwater had risen to [ankle] depth, making it difficult to walk through the streets.
examples.cn: 洪水已经上涨到[脚踝]深，在街道上行走十分困难。

examples.en: Proper footwear provides crucial support for the [ankle] during high-impact exercise.
examples.cn: 适合的鞋履在高强度运动中为[脚踝]提供关键支撑。

examples.en: The company is celebrating its fiftieth [anniversary] with a special exhibition of its history.
examples.cn: 公司正在以一场特别的历史展览庆祝其五十周年[纪念日]。

examples.en: They renewed their vows on their twenty-fifth wedding [anniversary] in front of close family.
examples.cn: 他们在结婚二十五周年[纪念日]在近亲面前重新宣誓。

examples.en: The [anniversary] of the armistice was marked by a national ceremony at the war memorial.
examples.cn: 停战[周年纪念日]由一场在战争纪念碑举行的国家仪式来纪念。

examples.en: The orchestra performs a special concert each year to mark the [anniversary] of its founding.
examples.cn: 乐团每年举办特别音乐会，以纪念其创立[周年纪念]。

examples.en: On the [anniversary] of the disaster, survivors gathered to pay tribute to those who had perished.
examples.cn: 在灾难[周年纪念日]，幸存者聚集在一起向遇难者致敬。

examples.en: The prime minister [announced] a sweeping package of economic reforms at the press conference.
examples.cn: 首相在新闻发布会上[宣布]了一揽子全面的经济改革方案。

examples.en: The university [announced] the results of the entrance examination on its official website.
examples.cn: 大学在其官方网站上[公布]了入学考试的结果。

examples.en: The chairperson [announced] that the next committee meeting would be held online.
examples.cn: 主席[通知]下次委员会会议将在线上举行。

examples.en: The first blossoms [announced] the arrival of spring after the long, cold winter.
examples.cn: 第一批花朵[宣示]了漫长寒冬后春天的到来。

examples.en: The host [announced] each performer by name before they took to the stage.
examples.cn: 主持人在每位表演者上台前都[介绍]了其姓名。

examples.en: The [announcement] of the merger sent the company's stock price soaring overnight.
examples.cn: 合并[公告]一夜之间使公司股价大幅攀升。

examples.en: The official [announcement] of the election results was delayed due to technical problems.
examples.cn: 选举结果的官方[公告]因技术问题而推迟发布。

examples.en: A public address [announcement] informed passengers of the unexpected change to the schedule.
examples.cn: 一则广播[通知]告知乘客时刻表的意外变更。

examples.en: The [announcement] posted on the notice board invited applications for the leadership position.
examples.cn: 张贴在公告栏上的[启事]邀请人们申请领导职位。

examples.en: The scientist's [announcement] of a breakthrough in cancer research made international headlines.
examples.cn: 科学家关于癌症研究突破的[宣布]登上了国际头条。

examples.en: It [annoys] her when colleagues interrupt meetings with unrelated personal conversations.
examples.cn: 同事在会议中插入无关的私人谈话让她感到[烦恼]。

examples.en: The persistent noise from the construction work [annoyed] residents throughout the summer.
examples.cn: 建筑施工持续的噪音在整个夏天令居民感到[烦扰]。

examples.en: He was [annoyed] by the constant interruptions during his attempt to concentrate.
examples.cn: 他在试图集中注意力时不断被打断，为此感到[恼火]。

examples.en: Her tendency to dismiss others' ideas without consideration [annoyed] even her closest colleagues.
examples.cn: 她不加考虑就否定他人想法的倾向[惹怒]了连她最亲密的同事。

examples.en: Students were asked not to [annoy] the librarian with requests that were clearly outside her role.
examples.cn: 学生被要求不要以明显超出职责范围的请求[打扰]图书管理员。

examples.sense: adj. 每年的；一年一度的
examples.en: The [annual] conference brings together researchers from over forty countries to share findings.
examples.cn: [一年一度]的会议汇聚了来自四十多个国家的研究人员共享研究成果。

examples.sense: adj. 年度的；按年计算的
examples.en: The company's [annual] report showed a significant increase in revenue compared to the previous year.
examples.cn: 公司的[年度]报告显示，与上年相比收入显著增长。

examples.en: Sunflowers are popular [annuals] that bloom spectacularly before dying off in autumn.
examples.cn: 向日葵是受欢迎的[一年生植物]，在秋天枯萎前开得绚烂夺目。

examples.sense: adj. 年均的；每年的（统计）
examples.en: The [annual] inflation rate reached its highest level in over a decade last year.
examples.cn: 去年的[年]通货膨胀率达到了十多年来的最高水平。

examples.en: The school publishes an [annual] that documents student achievements throughout the academic year.
examples.cn: 学校出版一本[年刊]，记录整个学年的学生成就。

examples.en: She submitted [another] revised draft after the editor suggested further improvements.
examples.cn: 在编辑建议进一步改进后，她提交了[另一]份修订稿。

examples.en: Taking [another] approach to the problem led the research team to an unexpected solution.
examples.cn: 采用[不同]的方法解决问题使研究团队找到了意想不到的解决方案。

examples.en: One researcher proposed the theory; [another] spent years gathering evidence to support it.
examples.cn: 一位研究人员提出了这个理论；[另一位]花了数年时间收集证据来支持它。

examples.sense: det. 类似的；同样的（one ... another）
examples.en: One country's economic policy can trigger [another]'s inflation or recession.
examples.cn: 一个国家的经济政策可能引发[另一个]国家的通货膨胀或衰退。

examples.en: The project required [another] two months of work before it could be officially launched.
examples.cn: 该项目在正式启动前还需要[再]工作两个月。

examples.en: The examiner praised her for providing a nuanced [answer] to the essay question.
examples.cn: 考官赞扬她对论述题提供了一个有深度的[答案]。

examples.en: She [answered] every question with clarity and confidence during the panel interview.
examples.cn: 她在小组面试中清晰而自信地[回答]了每一个问题。

examples.sense: n. 解决方案；应对办法
examples.en: There is no simple [answer] to the complex challenge of reducing carbon emissions globally.
examples.cn: 对于减少全球碳排放这一复杂挑战，没有简单的[解决方案]。

examples.en: She [answered] the phone immediately upon seeing the caller's name on the screen.
examples.cn: 她一看到屏幕上显示的来电者姓名，立即[接听]了电话。

examples.en: The new design [answers] the need for a lighter, more energy-efficient vehicle.
examples.cn: 新设计[满足]了对更轻便、更节能汽车的需求。

examples.en: Researchers discovered that [ants] can navigate complex environments using chemical signals.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现[蚂蚁]能够利用化学信号在复杂环境中导航。

examples.en: The colony of [ants] worked with remarkable coordination to transport food to the nest.
examples.cn: [蚂蚁]群落以惊人的协调配合将食物运送到巢穴。

examples.en: He was like an [ant] in his industry, methodically completing every task assigned to him.
examples.cn: 他在工作上像一只[蚂蚁]，有条不紊地完成分配给他的每项任务。

examples.en: The rainforest floor teems with [ants], which play a critical role in the ecosystem.
examples.cn: 雨林地面上[蚂蚁]密布，它们在生态系统中扮演着关键角色。

examples.en: Like an [ant] carrying a load many times its weight, she persevered against all odds.
examples.cn: 像[蚂蚁]承载数倍体重的负荷一样，她不顾一切地坚持下去。

examples.en: [Antarctic] ice sheets contain vast reserves of fresh water crucial to global sea levels.
examples.cn: [南极]冰盖蕴藏着对全球海平面至关重要的大量淡水储备。

examples.en: Scientists conduct year-round research at [Antarctic] stations to monitor climate change.
examples.cn: 科学家在[南极]科学考察站全年开展研究，以监测气候变化。

examples.en: The [Antarctic] temperatures experienced by the climbers tested their endurance to the limit.
examples.cn: 登山者所经历的[极寒]温度将他们的耐力考验到了极限。

examples.en: Melting sea ice threatens the habitat of [Antarctic] penguins and seals.
examples.cn: 海冰融化威胁着[南极洲]企鹅和海豹的栖息地。

examples.en: Roald Amundsen's [Antarctic] expedition in 1911 reached the South Pole for the first time.
examples.cn: 罗尔德·阿蒙森1911年的[南极]探险首次到达了南极点。

examples.en: [Antarctica] is the coldest, driest, and windiest continent on Earth.
examples.cn: [南极洲]是地球上最寒冷、最干燥、风力最强的大陆。

examples.en: International scientists collaborate at research stations across [Antarctica] to study the climate.
examples.cn: 国际科学家在[南极洲]各科考站合作研究气候。

examples.en: The accelerating melting of [Antarctica]'s ice is raising sea levels at an alarming rate.
examples.cn: [南极洲]冰层的加速融化正以令人担忧的速度抬高海平面。

examples.en: Captain Scott's tragic expedition to [Antarctica] in 1912 captured the world's imagination.
examples.cn: 斯科特船长1912年的[南极洲]悲剧探险吸引了世人的目光。

examples.en: Under the Antarctic Treaty, [Antarctica] is designated as a scientific preserve free from military activity.
examples.cn: 根据南极条约，[南极洲]被指定为禁止军事活动的科学保护区。

examples.en: She inherited a valuable [antique] clock that had been in her family for three generations.
examples.cn: 她继承了一件在家族中传了三代的珍贵[古董]钟。

examples.en: The manor house was furnished with [antique] pieces from various periods of European history.
examples.cn: 庄园里摆放着来自欧洲历史各时期的[古式]家具。

examples.en: The market stall was piled high with [antiques] ranging from pocket watches to oil paintings.
examples.cn: 集市摊位上堆满了[古旧物品]，从怀表到油画应有尽有。

examples.sense: adj. 过时的；陈旧的（口语）
examples.en: The [antique] filing system was replaced by a modern digital database.
examples.cn: [陈旧]的档案系统被现代数字数据库所取代。

examples.en: The [antique] elegance of the restored theatre drew visitors from across the region.
examples.cn: 修缮后剧院的[古典]雅致吸引了来自整个地区的访客。

examples.en: Exam [anxiety] can significantly impair a student's ability to perform at their best.
examples.cn: 考试[焦虑]会显著影响学生发挥最佳水平的能力。

examples.en: There is growing [anxiety] among scientists about the long-term effects of microplastic pollution.
examples.cn: 科学家对微塑料污染的长期影响越来越[忧虑]。

examples.en: Clinical [anxiety] is a recognised mental health condition that requires professional support.
examples.cn: 临床[焦虑症]是一种需要专业支持的公认心理健康状况。

examples.sense: n. 渴望；切望（to do sth.）
examples.en: Her [anxiety] to please everyone around her often left her feeling exhausted and resentful.
examples.cn: 她[渴望]让周围所有人满意，这常常使她感到疲惫和怨恨。

examples.en: The community felt a sense of collective [anxiety] as unemployment figures continued to rise.
examples.cn: 随着失业数字持续上升，社区感受到了集体的[不安]。

examples.en: She felt [anxious] as she waited for the results of the medical examination.
examples.cn: 等待体检结果时，她感到[焦虑]不安。

examples.en: He was [anxious] about his son's welfare after hearing reports of unrest in the city.
examples.cn: 听到城市动乱的报道后，他非常[担心]儿子的安危。

examples.en: The delegates were [anxious] to reach an agreement before the summit concluded.
examples.cn: 代表们[急切]希望在峰会结束前达成协议。

examples.sense: adj. 让人不安的；令人焦虑的
examples.en: The long silence from the rescue team made the waiting families increasingly [anxious].
examples.cn: 救援队长时间的沉默使等待的家属越来越[焦虑]。

examples.en: She was [anxious] to make a good impression at her first professional conference.
examples.cn: 她[急切]希望在第一次专业会议上留下好印象。

examples.en: Students with [any] questions regarding the assignment are welcome to visit during office hours.
examples.cn: 对作业有[任何]疑问的学生欢迎在答疑时间前来咨询。

examples.sense: det. 一些；若干（疑问/否定）
examples.en: The researchers could not find [any] direct evidence linking the two phenomena.
examples.cn: 研究人员找不到[任何]将这两种现象直接联系起来的证据。

examples.sense: adv. 稍微；一点（用于比较）
examples.en: The revised policy was not [any] better than the original one in practice.
examples.cn: 修订后的政策在实践中并不[比]原来的好[多少]。

examples.sense: det. 随便哪个；无论哪个
examples.en: [Any] candidate with the required qualifications and experience may submit an application.
examples.cn: 具备所需资质和经验的[任何]候选人都可以提交申请。

examples.en: The principle of equality before the law applies to [any] individual without exception.
examples.cn: 法律面前人人平等的原则适用于[任何]个人，无一例外。

examples.en: Is there [anybody] in the organisation who has experience with machine learning systems?
examples.cn: 组织中有[任何人]有机器学习系统经验吗？

examples.sense: pron. 无论谁；无论什么人
examples.en: [Anybody] willing to contribute ideas to the project is welcome to attend the brainstorming session.
examples.cn: 愿意为项目贡献想法的[任何人]都欢迎参加头脑风暴会议。

examples.en: She quickly became [somebody] in the academic community after her landmark publication.
examples.cn: 她的里程碑式著作发表后，很快在学术界成了[举足轻重的人物]。

examples.en: Has [anybody] managed to replicate the experimental results reported in the paper?
examples.cn: 有[任何人]设法重复了论文中报告的实验结果吗？

examples.en: [Anybody] who claims to have a perfect solution to climate change is not being honest.
examples.cn: [任何]声称对气候变化有完美解决方案的人都是不诚实的。

examples.sense: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样
examples.en: The weather was terrible, but they decided to proceed with the outdoor ceremony [anyhow].
examples.cn: 天气很糟糕，但他们决定[无论如何]继续举行户外仪式。

examples.en: The report was compiled [anyhow], without checking the accuracy of the data.
examples.cn: 报告是[马马虎虎]编制的，没有核实数据的准确性。

examples.en: The change was inevitable [anyhow], so there was little point delaying the announcement.
examples.cn: 这一变化[反正]是不可避免的，所以没有什么必要推迟公告。

examples.sense: adv. 随意地；不加整理地
examples.en: His notes were scattered [anyhow] across the desk, making it hard to find what he needed.
examples.cn: 他的笔记[杂乱无章]地散落在桌上，很难找到所需的内容。

examples.en: [Anyhow], the important thing is that the mission was accomplished despite the difficulties.
examples.cn: [总之]，重要的是尽管困难重重，任务还是完成了。

examples.en: [Anyone] who witnesses the incident is urged to contact the police immediately.
examples.cn: 目击该事件的[任何人]被敦促立即联系警察。

examples.en: Is there [anyone] available to cover the afternoon shift on short notice?
examples.cn: 有[任何人]可以临时顶替下午的班次吗？

examples.en: The position is open to [anyone] with the relevant qualifications and a genuine interest.
examples.cn: 该职位向具备相关资质和真正兴趣的[任何人]开放。

examples.en: The confidential report was not shared with [anyone] outside the core management team.
examples.cn: 机密报告没有与核心管理团队以外的[任何人]分享。

examples.en: The course is designed so that [anyone] with basic computing skills can follow it.
examples.cn: 该课程的设计使具备基本计算机技能的[任何人]都能跟上学习。

examples.en: She was prepared to do [anything] within her power to support the struggling community.
examples.cn: 她准备竭尽所能做[任何事]来支持这个困难的社区。

examples.en: Is there [anything] the committee can do to speed up the approval process?
examples.cn: 委员会能做[任何事]来加快审批流程吗？

examples.en: There is [nothing] in the data that suggests a causal relationship between the two variables.
examples.cn: 数据中没有[任何]内容表明两个变量之间存在因果关系。

examples.en: The journalist was determined to uncover [anything] that had been deliberately concealed.
examples.cn: 记者决心揭露被故意隐瞒的[任何]事情。

examples.en: The process was [anything] but straightforward — it involved months of complex negotiations.
examples.cn: 这个过程[绝非]一帆风顺——它涉及数月复杂的谈判。

examples.sense: adv. 任何地方；无论哪里
examples.en: Thanks to digital technology, students can now access quality education from [anywhere] in the world.
examples.cn: 得益于数字技术，学生现在可以从世界[任何地方]获取优质教育。

examples.en: Have you seen [anywhere] in the literature a reference to this particular phenomenon?
examples.cn: 你在文献中有没有[任何地方]看到对这一特定现象的引用？

examples.sense: adv. 没有任何地方（否定）
examples.en: The missing report could not be found [anywhere] in the department's electronic archives.
examples.cn: 在部门的电子档案中[任何地方]都找不到那份缺失的报告。

examples.en: Climate change is not a problem confined to one region — it is felt [anywhere] on the planet.
examples.cn: 气候变化不是一个局限于某一地区的问题——它在地球[任何地方]都能感受到。

examples.sense: adv. 大约；左右（not get anywhere）
examples.en: Despite months of effort, the negotiations did not seem to be getting [anywhere].
examples.cn: 尽管努力了数月，谈判似乎仍然没有[任何进展]。

examples.en: The two research teams worked [apart] from each other to prevent any unconscious bias.
examples.cn: 两个研究团队[分开]工作，以防止任何无意识的偏见。

examples.en: [Apart] from the budget constraints, the project is progressing according to plan.
examples.cn: [除了]预算限制之外，项目正在按计划推进。

examples.en: The ancient artefact fell [apart] when the conservators attempted to clean it.
examples.cn: 修复师尝试清洁时，这件古文物[碎裂]了。

examples.en: The two cities are three hundred kilometres [apart] and connected by a high-speed rail line.
examples.cn: 这两座城市[相距]三百公里，由高速铁路连接。

examples.sense: adj. 独特的；与众不同（set apart）
examples.en: Her ability to synthesise complex information sets her [apart] from most other analysts.
examples.cn: 她综合复杂信息的能力使她在大多数其他分析师中[脱颖而出]。

examples.en: She rented a small [apartment] in the city centre to reduce her daily commute.
examples.cn: 她在市中心租了一套小[公寓]，以减少每日通勤时间。

examples.sense: n. 高档公寓；豪华套房
examples.en: The luxury [apartment] came with a rooftop terrace overlooking the entire city skyline.
examples.cn: 这套豪华[公寓]配有俯瞰整个城市天际线的屋顶露台。

examples.en: The building contains thirty [apartments] of varying sizes to accommodate different household needs.
examples.cn: 这栋楼有三十套大小不一的[公寓]，以满足不同家庭需求。

examples.en: Finding an affordable [apartment] in a major city has become increasingly challenging for young professionals.
examples.cn: 对年轻专业人士来说，在大城市找到负担得起的[公寓]变得越来越困难。

examples.en: The royal family occupied a private [apartment] within the palace, away from public areas.
examples.cn: 皇室家族在宫殿内远离公共区域的私人[套间]居住。

examples.en: The company issued a formal statement to [apologize] for the data breach that affected thousands.
examples.cn: 公司发表了正式声明，就影响数千人的数据泄露[致歉]。

examples.en: The pamphlet was written to [apologize] for the government's controversial foreign policy decisions.
examples.cn: 这本小册子是为政府有争议的外交政策决定[辩护]而写的。

examples.en: He [apologized] sincerely to his colleague for the careless remark made in the heat of the moment.
examples.cn: 他真诚地向同事[道歉]，为一时冲动说出的粗心失言表示歉意。

examples.en: A good leader is not too proud to [apologize] when they have made a genuine mistake.
examples.cn: 一个好的领导者不会在真的犯错时因自尊而不肯[道歉]。

examples.en: The hospital administration [apologized] to the patient's family for the delay in treatment.
examples.cn: 医院管理层就治疗延误向患者家属[致歉]。

examples.en: The official [apology] from the government was welcomed by affected communities as a first step.
examples.cn: 政府的正式[道歉]被受影响社区视为第一步，受到了欢迎。

examples.en: She accepted his [apology] graciously and the disagreement was quickly resolved.
examples.cn: 她大度地接受了他的[道歉]，分歧很快得到了解决。

examples.sense: n. 蹩脚货；代替品（an apology for）
examples.en: The meal could only be described as an [apology] for fine dining — the portions were tiny and tasteless.
examples.cn: 这顿饭只能被描述为精致餐饮的[劣质替代品]——分量微小且无味。

examples.en: The essay serves as an [apology] for the philosopher's controversial stance on free will.
examples.cn: 这篇文章是对该哲学家关于自由意志的争议立场的[辩护文]。

examples.en: He owed the committee no [apology] — his decision had been fully justified by the evidence.
examples.cn: 他无需向委员会[道歉]——他的决定已经得到了证据的充分支持。

examples.sense: adj. 明显的；显而易见的
examples.en: It was [apparent] from the data that the new treatment was significantly more effective.
examples.cn: 从数据中可以[明显]看出，新疗法的效果明显更好。

examples.en: The [apparent] calm of the negotiations masked deep underlying tensions between the parties.
examples.cn: 谈判[表面上]的平静掩盖了各方之间深层的紧张关系。

examples.en: What seemed an [apparent] contradiction turned out to be a subtle distinction.
examples.cn: 看似[表面上]矛盾的东西原来是一种细微的区别。

examples.sense: adj. 有据可查的；有理可循的
examples.en: There was no [apparent] reason for the sudden collapse in consumer confidence.
examples.cn: 消费者信心突然下滑没有[明显]原因。

examples.sense: adj. 推定的；名义上的（heir apparent）
examples.en: As the [apparent] frontrunner, she was under intense media scrutiny throughout the campaign.
examples.cn: 作为[明显]的领先者，她在整个竞选过程中受到了媒体的严密审视。

examples.en: The defendant's lawyers [appealed] the conviction on the grounds of new forensic evidence.
examples.cn: 被告的律师以新的法证证据为由，就定罪[提出上诉]。

examples.en: The [appeal] of living in a vibrant city lies in its cultural diversity and opportunities.
examples.cn: 居住在充满活力城市的[吸引力]在于其文化多样性和发展机遇。

examples.en: The charity [appealed] for public donations to fund emergency relief operations abroad.
examples.cn: 慈善机构[呼吁]公众捐款，为海外紧急救援行动提供资金。

examples.en: The court rejected the [appeal] but permitted the case to be reviewed by a higher tribunal.
examples.cn: 法院驳回了[上诉]，但允许案件由更高级别的法庭审查。

examples.en: The research topic [appealed] to her because it combined linguistics with cognitive science.
examples.cn: 这个研究课题[吸引]了她，因为它结合了语言学和认知科学。

examples.en: New evidence [appeared] to contradict the findings that had been accepted for decades.
examples.cn: 新证据[出现]，与数十年来被接受的研究结论相矛盾。

examples.en: The proposal [appears] reasonable on the surface but contains several critical flaws.
examples.cn: 这个提案表面上[看起来]合理，但包含几个关键缺陷。

examples.en: The author will [appear] at the book fair to sign copies and answer readers' questions.
examples.cn: 这位作者将在书展上[亮相]，为读者签书并解答问题。

examples.en: All parties involved are required to [appear] before the tribunal on the specified date.
examples.cn: 所有相关当事人须于指定日期[出庭]接受法庭审理。

examples.en: Her groundbreaking article [appeared] in the leading scientific journal last spring.
examples.cn: 她的开创性文章于去年春天[发表]在顶尖科学期刊上。

examples.en: Her professional [appearance] and confident manner immediately impressed the interviewing panel.
examples.cn: 她专业的[外表]和自信的举止立即给面试小组留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The [appearance] of the prime minister at the rally surprised even his closest advisers.
examples.cn: 首相出现在集会上令连他最亲密的顾问都感到惊讶。

examples.en: Despite [appearances], the financial situation of the company was precarious.
examples.cn: 尽管从[外表]来看，公司的财务状况却是岌岌可危的。

examples.en: The [appearance] of the novel in print marked a turning point in the author's career.
examples.cn: 这部小说的[出版]标志着作者职业生涯的一个转折点。

examples.en: Her [appearance] as a witness was crucial to establishing the timeline of events.
examples.cn: 她以证人身份的[出庭]对于确定事件时间线至关重要。

examples.en: He was rushed into surgery after his [appendix] became inflamed and ruptured.
examples.cn: 他的[阑尾]发炎穿孔后被紧急送入手术室。

examples.en: The raw data supporting the study's conclusions are provided in the [appendix] of the paper.
examples.cn: 支持研究结论的原始数据在论文的[附录]中提供。

examples.en: Readers seeking additional statistical detail should consult the technical [appendix].
examples.cn: 寻求更多统计细节的读者应参阅技术[附录]。

examples.en: The contract included an [appendix] listing all the specific terms and conditions.
examples.cn: 合同附有一个列明所有具体条款和条件的[附录]。

examples.sense: n. 阑尾（比喻，多余的部分）
examples.en: Some critics view the lengthy preamble as an [appendix] to the main argument.
examples.cn: 一些批评者将冗长的前言视为主要论点的[附赘]。

examples.en: Stress and overwork had significantly reduced her [appetite] for regular meals.
examples.cn: 压力和过度工作大大减少了她对正餐的[食欲]。

examples.en: His [appetite] for knowledge was insatiable — he read voraciously across many disciplines.
examples.cn: 他对知识的[渴望]贪得无厌——他广泛涉猎多个学科。

examples.en: The public's [appetite] for reliable, in-depth journalism has grown in the era of misinformation.
examples.cn: 在虚假信息盛行的时代，公众对可靠、深度新闻的[渴求]有所增长。

examples.en: The corporation's [appetite] for profit led it to neglect its environmental responsibilities.
examples.cn: 该公司对利润的[贪欲]导致其忽视了环境责任。

examples.en: The electorate's [appetite] for change drove a decisive shift in the voting patterns.
examples.cn: 选民对变革的[渴望]推动了投票模式的决定性转变。

examples.en: The audience rose to their feet and [applauded] warmly at the end of the extraordinary performance.
examples.cn: 观众起立，在精彩表演结束时热情[鼓掌]喝彩。

examples.en: The international community [applauded] the government's decision to reduce carbon emissions.
examples.cn: 国际社会[称赞]政府减少碳排放的决定。

examples.en: She [applauded] her students' efforts even when the results fell short of expectations.
examples.cn: 即使结果不尽如人意，她也[赞扬]学生们的努力。

examples.en: The committee [applauded] the researcher's innovative approach to a long-standing problem.
examples.cn: 委员会[称赞]了研究人员解决长期问题的创新方法。

examples.en: Critics and audiences alike [applauded] the film as a masterpiece of contemporary cinema.
examples.cn: 批评家和观众都[称赞]这部电影是当代电影的杰作。

examples.en: An [apple] a day may not keep the doctor away, but a balanced diet certainly helps.
examples.cn: 每天一个[苹果]也许不能让你不用看医生，但均衡饮食肯定有帮助。

examples.en: The orchard was full of [apple] trees heavy with ripe fruit ready for harvest.
examples.cn: 果园里满是挂满成熟果实、即将收获的[苹果]树。

examples.en: She prefers tart [apples] like Granny Smith over sweeter varieties for baking pies.
examples.cn: 她偏爱用口味酸涩的青苹果而非甜品种来烤苹果派。

examples.en: [Apple]'s latest product launch attracted unprecedented global media coverage.
examples.cn: [苹果]公司的最新产品发布吸引了前所未有的全球媒体报道。

examples.en: In the biblical narrative, the forbidden [apple] symbolises the human desire for knowledge.
examples.cn: 在圣经叙事中，禁忌的[苹果]象征着人类对知识的渴望。

examples.en: Each [applicant] was assessed on their academic record, personal statement, and interview performance.
examples.cn: 每位[申请人]根据其学业记录、个人陈述和面试表现进行评估。

examples.en: The number of [applicants] for the graduate position exceeded three hundred within a week.
examples.cn: 研究生职位的[申请人]人数在一周内超过了三百人。

examples.en: [Applicants] are required to submit supporting documents along with their completed forms.
examples.cn: [申请人]须连同填妥的表格一并提交支持文件。

examples.en: Successful [applicants] will be notified by email within ten working days.
examples.cn: 申请成功的[申请人]将在十个工作日内通过电子邮件收到通知。

examples.en: The university welcomes [applicants] from diverse educational and cultural backgrounds.
examples.cn: 该大学欢迎来自不同教育和文化背景的[申请者]。

examples.en: She submitted her university [application] six months before the closing deadline.
examples.cn: 她在截止日期前六个月提交了大学[申请]。

examples.en: The [application] of artificial intelligence to medical diagnostics is transforming patient care.
examples.cn: 人工智能在医疗诊断中的[应用]正在改变患者护理方式。

examples.en: The mobile [application] allows users to track their carbon footprint in real time.
examples.cn: 这款手机[应用程序]让用户能够实时追踪自己的碳足迹。

examples.en: The [application] of sunscreen before exposure to ultraviolet radiation reduces the risk of skin cancer.
examples.cn: 在暴露于紫外线辐射前[涂抹]防晒霜可降低皮肤癌风险。

examples.en: Her success was the result of years of careful study and diligent [application] of what she had learned.
examples.cn: 她的成功是多年认真学习和勤奋[运用]所学知识的结果。

examples.en: She decided to [apply] for a research grant to fund her investigation into renewable materials.
examples.cn: 她决定[申请]一笔研究经费，以资助她对可再生材料的研究。

examples.en: Students must [apply] theoretical knowledge to real-world problems in their final projects.
examples.cn: 学生必须在最终项目中将理论知识[应用]于现实问题。

examples.en: The technician carefully [applied] the protective coating to the metal surface.
examples.cn: 技术员仔细地将保护涂层[涂抹]在金属表面上。

examples.en: The new safety regulations [apply] to all manufacturers operating within the country.
examples.cn: 新的安全法规[适用于]在该国境内运营的所有制造商。

examples.en: If you [apply] yourself consistently, you will see steady improvement in your scores.
examples.cn: 如果你始终[专心投入]，你将看到成绩的稳定提升。

examples.en: The board [appointed] a new chief executive to lead the company through its restructuring.
examples.cn: 董事会[任命]了一位新的首席执行官来领导公司完成重组。

examples.sense: v. 指定；安排（时间、地点）
examples.en: The judge [appointed] a date for the preliminary hearing of the case.
examples.cn: 法官[指定]了案件初步听审的日期。

examples.en: She was [appointed] as the regional coordinator for the international volunteer programme.
examples.cn: 她被[任命]为国际志愿者项目的区域协调员。

examples.en: The [appointed] conference room was equipped with state-of-the-art presentation technology.
examples.cn: [配备齐全]的会议室装有最先进的演示技术。

examples.en: The statute [appoints] a fixed penalty for each category of violation.
examples.cn: 该法规对每类违规[规定]了固定罚款金额。

examples.en: She made an [appointment] with the specialist three weeks in advance.
examples.cn: 她提前三周与专科医生预约了[就诊时间]。

examples.en: His [appointment] as director of the institute was widely celebrated by colleagues.
examples.cn: 他被[任命]为研究所所长，受到了同事们的广泛欢迎。

examples.en: She accepted the senior academic [appointment] at the prestigious research university.
examples.cn: 她接受了著名研究大学的高级学术[职位]。

examples.en: The manager had back-to-back [appointments] throughout the morning, leaving no time for other tasks.
examples.cn: 经理整个上午都有连续的[约见]，没有时间做其他任务。

examples.en: The luxurious hotel room came with all the expected [appointments] of a five-star establishment.
examples.cn: 豪华酒店房间配备了五星级酒店应有的所有[设施]。

examples.en: I deeply [appreciate] the time and effort you invested in reviewing my research proposal.
examples.cn: 我深深[感激]您花时间和精力审阅我的研究提案。

examples.en: Living abroad helped her [appreciate] aspects of her own culture she had previously taken for granted.
examples.cn: 在海外生活帮助她[欣赏]自己文化中以前视为理所当然的方面。

examples.en: Many people fail to [appreciate] the complexity of the issues involved in climate policy.
examples.cn: 许多人未能[认识到]气候政策所涉及问题的复杂性。

examples.en: Property in the city has [appreciated] significantly over the past decade.
examples.cn: 城市房产在过去十年中[大幅增值]。

examples.en: A good mentor [appreciates] the unique potential of each student and nurtures it carefully.
examples.cn: 好的导师[珍视]每位学生独特的潜力并精心培养它。

examples.en: She expressed her [appreciation] to the medical team for their exceptional care and dedication.
examples.cn: 她向医疗团队表达了对其出色护理和奉献精神的[感激]之情。

examples.en: His deep [appreciation] of classical music was evident in the way he described each composition.
examples.cn: 他在描述每首乐曲时，其对古典音乐的深厚[鉴赏力]显而易见。

examples.en: A proper [appreciation] of historical context is essential when analysing political events.
examples.cn: 在分析政治事件时，对历史背景的正确[认识]至关重要。

examples.en: The [appreciation] of the local currency made exports less competitive in global markets.
examples.cn: 当地货币的[升值]使出口在全球市场上的竞争力下降。

examples.en: The artist's work received widespread [appreciation] at the international exhibition.
examples.cn: 这位艺术家的作品在国际展览上获得了广泛[赞赏]。

examples.en: A multidisciplinary [approach] is often more effective than relying on a single methodology.
examples.cn: 跨学科[方法]通常比依赖单一方法论更有效。

examples.en: As the deadline [approached], the team intensified their efforts to complete the project.
examples.cn: 随着截止日期[临近]，团队加大了完成项目的努力。

examples.en: She [approached] the publisher directly with her manuscript rather than going through an agent.
examples.cn: 她直接带着手稿[接洽]出版商，而没有通过代理人。

examples.en: The narrow [approach] to the harbour made navigation particularly challenging in rough weather.
examples.cn: 通往港口的狭窄[进路]使得在恶劣天气中导航格外困难。

examples.en: The consultant [approached] each client's situation with fresh eyes and without preconceptions.
examples.cn: 顾问以全新的眼光[处理]每位客户的情况，不带任何先入之见。

examples.en: Using [appropriate] language in academic writing demonstrates intellectual maturity and precision.
examples.cn: 在学术写作中使用[恰当]的语言体现了智识成熟度和精确性。

examples.en: She selected an [appropriate] outfit for the formal dinner without requiring guidance.
examples.cn: 她无需指导便为正式晚宴选择了[合适]的服装。

examples.en: The committee [appropriated] additional funds specifically for rural infrastructure development.
examples.cn: 委员会专门为农村基础设施发展[拨付]了额外资金。

examples.en: He was found to have [appropriated] company resources for personal use without authorisation.
examples.cn: 他被发现未经授权[挪用]了公司资源用于个人用途。

examples.en: An [appropriate] response to criticism should acknowledge the concern while offering a reasoned defence.
examples.cn: 对批评的[恰当]回应应在提供有理据辩护的同时承认有关关切。

examples.en: The planning committee [approved] the construction of a new public library in the town centre.
examples.cn: 规划委员会[批准]在市中心建设一座新公共图书馆。

examples.en: Not everyone [approved] of the management's decision to downsize the research department.
examples.cn: 不是所有人都[赞成]管理层缩减研究部门规模的决定。

examples.en: The ethics board [approved] the clinical trial after thorough review of the protocol.
examples.cn: 道德委员会在对研究方案进行彻底审查后[批准]了临床试验。

examples.en: Her parents did not [approve] of the career choice she had made independently.
examples.cn: 她的父母不[赞成]她独立做出的职业选择。

examples.en: All financial transactions above a certain threshold must be [approved] by a senior manager.
examples.cn: 超过一定金额的所有财务交易必须获得高级经理的[批准]。

examples.en: The restoration of the ancient painting took [approximately] three years to complete.
examples.cn: 这幅古画的修复工作[大约]历时三年完成。

examples.en: [Approximately] forty percent of the world's population now has access to the internet.
examples.cn: 目前全球[大约]40%的人口可以上网。

examples.en: The total distance between the two capital cities is [approximately] eight thousand kilometres.
examples.cn: 两个首都之间的总距离[约]为八千公里。

examples.en: The study found that [approximately] two thirds of participants reported positive outcomes.
examples.cn: 研究发现，[大约]三分之二的参与者报告了积极的结果。

examples.en: The results [approximately] match the predictions made by the theoretical model.
examples.cn: 结果与理论模型的预测[大致]吻合。

examples.en: The academic conference is scheduled for the third week of [April] next year.
examples.cn: 学术会议定于明年[四月]第三周举行。

examples.en: In many parts of the world, [April] brings warm rains that encourage new plant growth.
examples.cn: 在世界许多地方，[四月]带来温暖的雨水，促进新植物的生长。

examples.en: His colleagues played an elaborate prank on him on the first of [April].
examples.cn: 他的同事在[四月]一日对他恶作剧了一番。

examples.en: The armistice was signed in [April] 1945, marking the end of the conflict in Europe.
examples.cn: 停战协议于1945年[四月]签署，标志着欧洲战事的终结。

examples.en: The cherry blossoms typically reach their peak in [April] across much of East Asia.
examples.cn: 在东亚大部分地区，樱花通常在[四月]达到盛开的顶峰。

examples.en: The chef tied on his [apron] and began preparing the ingredients for the evening menu.
examples.cn: 厨师系上[围裙]，开始准备晚间菜单的食材。

examples.en: The ground crew guided the aircraft carefully from the runway to the parking [apron].
examples.cn: 地勤人员小心地引导飞机从跑道开到停放[停机坪]。

examples.sense: n. 舞台延伸区域（剧院）
examples.en: The actor stepped forward onto the [apron] to deliver his monologue directly to the audience.
examples.cn: 演员走上[伸出式舞台]，直接向观众独白。

examples.en: The ball rolled off the lane and across the [apron] before reaching the gutter.
examples.cn: 球从球道上滚落，穿过[挡沙道]滑入边沟。

examples.sense: n. 前庭（车道或建筑物前）
examples.en: The delivery truck parked on the concrete [apron] in front of the warehouse.
examples.cn: 送货卡车停在仓库前的混凝土[前坪]上。

examples.sense: n./adj. 阿拉伯人；阿拉伯的
examples.en: [Arab] scholars made vital contributions to mathematics and astronomy during the medieval period.
examples.cn: 中世纪时期，[阿拉伯]学者对数学和天文学作出了重要贡献。

examples.en: The [Arab] League was founded in 1945 to coordinate policy among member states.
examples.cn: [阿拉伯]联盟成立于1945年，旨在协调成员国之间的政策。

examples.en: The [Arab] is one of the oldest horse breeds, renowned for its speed and endurance.
examples.cn: [阿拉伯马]是最古老的马匹品种之一，以其速度和耐力著称。

examples.en: [Arab] cuisine is known for its rich blend of spices and use of fresh herbs.
examples.cn: [阿拉伯]菜肴以其丰富的香料混合和鲜草药的使用而著称。

examples.en: The history and culture of the [Arab] world stretch back more than three thousand years.
examples.cn: [阿拉伯]世界的历史和文化可以追溯到三千多年前。

examples.sense: n./adj. 阿拉伯语；阿拉伯语的
examples.en: [Arabic] is spoken by over four hundred million people as their first language.
examples.cn: [阿拉伯语]是四亿多人的母语。

examples.sense: adj. 阿拉伯数字的（Arabic numerals）
examples.en: [Arabic] numerals — 0 through 9 — are used universally in mathematics and science.
examples.cn: [阿拉伯]数字（0至9）在数学和科学中被普遍使用。

examples.en: She spent a year studying [Arabic] to prepare for her fieldwork in the Middle East.
examples.cn: 她花了一年时间学习[阿拉伯语]，为在中东的实地考察做准备。

examples.en: The manuscript was written in [Arabic] script and required specialist translation.
examples.cn: 这份手稿用[阿拉伯语]文字书写，需要专业翻译。

examples.sense: n. 阿拉伯文（文字体系）
examples.en: Learning to read [Arabic] requires mastering a script that runs from right to left.
examples.cn: 学习阅读[阿拉伯文]需要掌握一种从右向左书写的文字。

examples.en: The committee was criticised for its [arbitrary] allocation of research funds without clear criteria.
examples.cn: 委员会因缺乏明确标准而[随意]分配研究经费而受到批评。

examples.en: Citizens have the right to protest against [arbitrary] decisions made by those in power.
examples.cn: 公民有权抗议当权者作出的[武断]决定。

examples.sense: adj. 非理性的；没有依据的
examples.en: Her objection seemed [arbitrary] to those who had not read the background documentation.
examples.cn: 她的反对意见对于没有阅读背景文件的人来说似乎是[没有依据]的。

examples.sense: adj. 专横的；独断独行的
examples.en: The [arbitrary] exercise of power without accountability undermines democratic institutions.
examples.cn: 不负责任地[任意]行使权力损害了民主机构。

examples.en: An [arbitrary] constant is introduced when solving certain classes of differential equations.
examples.cn: 在求解某类微分方程时，需要引入一个[任意]常数。

examples.en: The triumphal [arch] at the city entrance was built to commemorate the historic victory.
examples.cn: 城市入口处的凯旋[拱门]是为纪念这一历史性胜利而建造的。

examples.en: The cat [arched] its back and hissed defensively at the approaching stranger.
examples.cn: 猫弯[拱]起背脊，对逼近的陌生人发出防御性的嘶嘶声。

examples.en: She gave an [arch] smile when asked about the surprise she had planned for the party.
examples.cn: 当被问及她为派对计划的惊喜时，她露出了一丝[狡黠]的微笑。

examples.en: Flat feet, where the [arch] of the foot is absent, can cause discomfort during prolonged walking.
examples.cn: 扁平足，即足[弓]缺失，在长时间行走时会引起不适。

examples.en: The [arch] villain of the story proved to be the most complex character in the novel.
examples.cn: 故事中的主要[大反派]被证明是小说中最复杂的角色。

examples.en: The [architect] designed a building that harmonised with the historic surroundings.
examples.cn: 这位[建筑师]设计了一座与历史环境和谐相融的建筑。

examples.sense: n. 设计者；缔造者（比喻）
examples.en: She was widely regarded as the [architect] of the nation's comprehensive educational reforms.
examples.cn: 她被广泛认为是该国全面教育改革的[设计者]。

examples.en: The software [architect] was responsible for designing the overall structure of the new platform.
examples.cn: 软件[架构师]负责设计新平台的整体结构。

examples.en: The [architect] of the peace agreement worked tirelessly to satisfy all parties involved.
examples.cn: 和平协议的[策划者]不辞辛劳地满足所有相关方。

examples.en: The landscape [architect] transformed the derelict urban site into a thriving public park.

examples.en: He felt deeply [ashamed] of his dishonest behaviour and resolved to make amends.

examples.en: International businesses are increasingly focusing on [Asian] consumer markets for future growth.

examples.en: She stepped [aside] to allow the emergency team to pass through the crowded corridor.

examples.cn: 她主修[生物化学]，并就酶在代谢疾病中的作用撰写了毕业论文。

examples.en: The [biochemistry] of human digestion involves complex sequences of chemical reactions in the stomach and intestines.
examples.cn: 人类消化的[生物化学]涉及胃和肠道中复杂的化学反应序列。

examples.en: Understanding [biochemistry] at the molecular level is essential for the development of new pharmaceutical compounds.
examples.cn: 在分子水平上理解[生物化学]对新型药物化合物的开发至关重要。

examples.en: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry has frequently been awarded for breakthroughs in [biochemistry] and molecular biology.

examples.en: The [biography] of Marie Curie reveals a life defined by intellectual brilliance and personal sacrifice.

examples.en: He spent four years researching archival documents before completing the comprehensive [biography].
examples.cn: 他花了四年时间研究档案文献，才完成这部详尽的[传记]。

examples.en: Reading the [biographies] of successful individuals can provide valuable insights into persistence and resilience.
examples.cn: 阅读成功人士的[传记]能为坚持和韧性提供宝贵的启示。

examples.en: The authorised [biography] was criticised for portraying the subject too favourably and omitting key failures.
examples.cn: 这部经授权的[传记]因将传主描绘得过于正面、忽略了重要失败而受到批评。

examples.en: Literary [biography] aims not only to chronicle events but also to illuminate the creative mind behind the work.
examples.cn: 文学[传记]不仅旨在记录事件，还旨在揭示作品背后的创造性思维。

examples.en: Her passion for [biology] was sparked by a documentary about the astonishing diversity of ocean life.
examples.cn: 一部关于海洋生命惊人多样性的纪录片点燃了她对[生物学]的热情。

examples.en: Modern [biology] has been transformed by the development of gene-editing technologies such as CRISPR.
examples.cn: 现代[生物学]已被CRISPR等基因编辑技术的发展所改变。

examples.en: Understanding the [biology] of viruses is essential for developing effective vaccines and treatments.
examples.cn: 了解病毒的[生物学]对开发有效的疫苗和治疗方法至关重要。

examples.en: The [biology] teacher took students on a field trip to observe freshwater ecosystems in their natural habitat.
examples.cn: [生物]老师带学生去实地考察，观察自然栖息地中的淡水生态系统。

examples.en: Conservation [biology] applies scientific knowledge to protect endangered species and restore damaged ecosystems.
examples.cn: 保育[生物学]运用科学知识保护濒危物种，修复受损生态系统。

examples.en: Migratory [birds] travel thousands of kilometres each year, navigating by magnetic fields and star patterns.
examples.cn: 候[鸟]每年迁徙数千公里，借助磁场和星象导航。

examples.en: The rare [bird] species was spotted for the first time in fifty years by a group of ornithologists.
examples.cn: 一群鸟类学家五十年来首次发现了这种罕见的[鸟]类。

examples.en: A [bird] in the hand is worth two in the bush, as the proverb warns against trading certainty for speculation.
examples.cn: 手中一[鸟]胜过林中二，这句谚语警告不要拿确定换取投机。

examples.en: Deforestation has destroyed the natural habitat of countless [bird] species across tropical regions.
examples.cn: 森林砍伐破坏了热带地区无数[鸟]类的自然栖息地。

examples.en: The morning chorus of [birds] outside the window served as her natural alarm clock throughout the summer.
examples.cn: 整个夏天，窗外清晨[鸟]鸣的合唱成为她天然的闹钟。

examples.en: The ornate [birdcage] hung in the parlour, housing a colourful parrot that greeted every visitor.

examples.cn: 动物福利倡导者认为，将野生鸟类关在[鸟笼]里限制了它们的自然行为。

examples.en: The antique [birdcage] was crafted from silver wire and valued as an artefact of Victorian craftsmanship.
